# About GD Goenka University

> GD Goenka University is one of India's leading multidisciplinary universities, internationally recognized for its commitment to academic excellence, innovation, and holistic development.
Offering 100+ undergraduate, postgraduate, doctoral, and professional programmes across diverse disciplines, the University provides students with an industry-aligned curriculum, experiential learning opportunities, and a strong research-driven ecosystem.
Recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC), GD Goenka University upholds the highest standards of quality education through a student-centric approach, world-class infrastructure, and distinguished faculty. Guided by the values of excellence, diversity, integrity, and innovation, the University empowers future-ready professionals, entrepreneurs, and responsible global citizens equipped to thrive in an evolving world.

34.content:
# Recognitions & Affiliations

##### University Grants Commission
The University Grants Commission of India is a statutory body set up by the Government of India in accordance to the UGC Act 1956 under Ministry of Education, and is charged with coordination, determination and maintenance of standards of higher education.
##### Bar Council of India
The Bar Council of India is a statutory body established under the section 4 of Advocates Act 1961 that regulates the legal practice and legal edition in India. Its members are elected from amongst the lawyers in India and as such represents the Indian bar. It prescribes standards of professional conduct, etiquettes and exercises disciplinary jurisdiction over the bar.
##### National Council For Teacher Education
National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) is a statutory body of Indian government set up under the National Council for Teacher Education Act, 1993 (#73, 1993) in 1995 is to formally oversee standards, procedures and processes in the Indian education system.
34.title: Recognitions & Affiliations

35.content:
# Recognitions & Affiliations

##### Pharmacy Council of India
The Pharmacy Council of India is the statutory body of government of India also called as central council constituted under the Pharmacy Act, 1948. The Council was first constituted on 4 March 1948. The Pharmacy Council of India is constituted by central government every five years.
##### Haryana State Council for Physiotherapy Panchkula, Haryana
Haryana State Council for Physiotherapy was constituted as an autonomous statutory body constituted by the Government of Haryana in the year 2020 under “Haryana State Council for Physiotherapy Act, 2020”. The council provides for registration of physiotherapists, standards of education, recognized qualifications and standards of practice to be complied with by the practicing physiotherapists.

##### Indian Council of Agricultural Research
The Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) is an autonomous body responsible for coordinating agricultural education and research in India. It reports to the Department of Agricultural Research and Education, Ministry of Agriculture. The Union Minister of Agriculture serves as its president. It is the largest network of agricultural research and education institutes in the world. The School of Agricultural Sciences at GD Goenka University has been awarded the esteemed Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) accreditation. This accreditation serves as a remarkable testament to the institution's dedication to excellence in agricultural education and research within India.

# Examination
We are dedicated to conducting all examinations in accordance with GD Goenka University examination policy, ensuring a fair and standardized assessment process.
Examinations shall be held as per planned arrangements conducted as per guiding procedures, in time, confidentiality and with complete integrity of purpose.
ERP
**Description**
The Examination Department of GD Goenka University has automated all the examination key processes on the University's ERP. All examination processes are managed in the most efficient way with the help of ERP. Also, the exam automation ensures that all exam data is organized in the desired way and stored on a single, central platform which provides easy access to everyone involved in the examination process.
76.title: Examination

77.content:
# Examination

Examinations involve a lot of activities, right from student exam enrollment in the courses, exam fee, preparing exam roll lists and creating exam date sheet to generation of exam admit cards and many more. If all these activities are not carried in the proper sequence, it may lead to a lot of repetitive tasks due to missing or disorganized data, along with loss of crucial time. The benefits of using smart exam enrollment management system helps in conducting authentic and reliable examinations, save more time cost and resources, easy and quick access of exam details for students and more sustainable way of conducting examinations in the University.

## Frequently Asked Questions
 * General

## General
## What are the student clubs available for students?
Several student clubs, including Photography, Dance, Vocal, and Instrumental, etc. are available under the Department of Student Welfare, providing students with diverse opportunities to explore their interests, showcase talents, and participate in co-curricular activities beyond academics.
## What is the code of conduct for events like Fresher’s Party?
University discipline applies at all events; proctorial support is available for coordination and safety.
## How are grievances handled?
Student may submit their concern through the official grievance portal or contact the Proctor’s Office. Academic matters should be addressed through the respective Head of Department or Dean.
112.title: School of Engineering & Sciences

113.content:
## How can students access academic information and official updates?
Students can view academic calendar, timetables, attendance, course content and assessments through DigiiCampus, while all official notifications and communications are shared via the University’s official email system.
## How do I reset my DigiiCampus password?
Use the ‘Forgot Password’ option on the login page or contact the IT Helpdesk.
## Do you provide Visa support letters?
Yes. After admission and fee formalities, the International Office issues Visa support letters and FRRO guidance.
## Are there language support services?
Orientation and peer‑mentoring are available. English communication related courses are part of the curriculum.
## Whom do I contact for urgent exam issues during MSE?
Report to Examination Control Room (ECR) during exam hours. The same can be notified to Floor In‑Charge/HoD if required.
113.title: School of Engineering & Sciences

114.content:
## Whom do I contact for urgent exam issues during MSE?
Report to Examination Control Room (ECR) during exam hours. The same can be notified to Floor In‑Charge/HoD if required.
## How do I escalate unresolved administrative issues?
Write to soes@gdgu.org with full details alongwith the reference number. The unresolved cases are escalated to Dean/Registrar as per the policy.
## Does GD Goenka University provide transport facilities?
Yes. The university offers safe and reliable AC bus services across Delhi-NCR, with routes covering major locations in Delhi, Gurugram, Faridabad, and nearby areas, ensuring comfortable and timely commuting for students and staff.

116.content:
## What are the labs available for the specialized programs at SoES?
Apple iMac and Bosch labs are equipped to support practical learning in design, programming, embedded systems,and automation. Interdiciplinary Project Lab is used for prototype design and concept evaluation. . Additionally, the Electro-Magnetic Lab, Aerodynamics Lab, Hydraulics Lab, Space Propulsion Lab, and Molecular Biology Lab provide hands-on experience to enhance learning and understanding in their respective domains.
## Where can I view the fee structure and payment schedules?
The detailed year-wise / semester-wise fee structure for each program is available program-wise on the website.
## What are the different types of scholarships available at GDGU?
Merit-based and need-based schemes for UG and PG programs are announced every year. Detailed information is available in the student handbook.
116.title: School of Engineering & Sciences

117.content:
## Is there a late fee or fine for delayed fee payment?
Yes. Students who miss the prescribed payment deadline must pay a late fee or fine as per the University’s Finance Policy.
## What is the duration for Mid Semester Examination (MSE) exams?
The duration of MSE for each course is 90 minutes for 30 marks.
## Can students leave before the exam ends?
No. Early exit is not allowed unless instructed by the Examination Control Room (ECR) for exceptional reasons.
## How is continuous assessment conducted at school?
Continuous assessment comprises of Project based Presentation / quiz / assignments /Mid Semester examination for theory courses and the assessments for lab courses inlcude Lab performance/ Lab Reports /Viva-voce. These components together determine the internal assessment marks.
117.title: School of Engineering & Sciences

118.content:
## What are the admission criteria for enrolling in BTech courses?
GD Goenka University is the best B Tech College in Delhi. For admission to our engineering courses, you must fulfil the following conditions: • You must have passed your Higher Secondary exam with Physics and Mathematics as your compulsory subject and an elective subject like Biology, Agriculture, Biotechnology etc. • You must secure at least 50% in your compulsory and optional subjects. • For lateral entry, you must qualify minimum three-year diploma examination with 50% marks.
## What are the computing facilities available at the school?
Each lab is equipped with a substantial number of branded computers and are named after a renowned computer scientists. ## Frequently Asked Questions
 * General
 * Clinical Psychology

## General
## Can I work independently after completing MA Clinical Psychology or PDCP?
Independent practice usually requires RCI registration. Since the MA programme is conditionally approved by RCI, once full approval is granted, graduates may register and practice independently. PDCP graduates may work under supervision as per RCI regulations.
## What is the General Psychology / B.A. (Hons) Psychology programme at GD Goenka University?
It is an undergraduate full‑time programme (4 years) in the School of Liberal Arts / Humanities & Social Sciences. The course covers theoretical and practical aspects of psychology: human behaviour, mental processes, research methods, psychological assessment, etc.
134.title: School of Liberal Arts

135.content:
## What programmes are offered in Clinical Psychology at GD Goenka University?
GD Goenka offers several programmes: a B.Sc. Clinical Psychology (Hons) (4 years), a M.A in Clinical Psychology (2 years), and a Professional Diploma in Clinical Psychology (PDCP) (1 year) at postgraduate level.
## What kind of clinical exposure or practical training is built into the programme?
GD Goenka has tied up with Fortis Healthcare as clinical training partner. Students get exposure to inpatient mental health units, real-time psychological assessments, therapeutic interventions, and multidisciplinary care – ensuring hands-on training and experience.
## What are the career opportunities / roles after completing these programmes?
Graduates can work as:
 * Clinical Psychologists (with RCI registration, where eligible)
 * Therapists / Counselors in hospitals, clinics, NGOs, rehabilitation centres
 * Mental Health Consultants
 * Researchers / Academicians
 * Psycho-social Support Workers
135.title: School of Liberal Arts

136.content:
## What is the duration of each programme?
 * B.Sc (Hons) Clinical Psychology – 4 years
 * M.A Clinical Psychology – 2 years
 * Professional Diploma – 1 year

## What’s the difference between Clinical Psychology and Counselling Psychology / General Psychology programmes?
Clinical Psychology focuses more on diagnosis, assessment, psychopathology, psychotherapy, and working with severe mental health disorders. Counselling Psychology focuses more on life adjustments, interpersonal issues, and wellness counselling.
## Are there prerequisites in terms of background (science / non-science) for the undergraduate programme?
Yes. For B.Sc (Hons) Clinical Psychology, applicants need to have completed 10+2 with Science stream.
## What kinds of assessments / courses are included in the curriculum?
Core courses include psychopathology, psychotherapy techniques, psychological testing, clinical casework, research methodology, statistics, and supervised clinical work/practica.
136.title: School of Liberal Arts

137.content:
## What are the prerequisites in terms of subjects studied in 10+2?
No strict requirement for psychology in 10+2. Students from any stream can apply, though a background in social sciences may help.
## Clinical Psychology
## Are there skills beyond theory that the programme helps develop?
Yes, students develop:
 * Research skills (design, data collection, statistics)
 * Communication skills (reports, presentations)
 * Critical thinking & problem-solving
 * Interpersonal / counselling skills
 * Ethical awareness.

## How is the curriculum structured (semesters and core vs electives)?
The first semesters focus on foundational subjects (introduction, biopsychology, individual differences, research methods). Later semesters cover advanced areas (disorders, intervention, counseling, electives) with project/practical work.
137.title: School of Liberal Arts

138.content:
## What sorts of practical / project work are included?
Includes psychological assessments, case studies, lab work, research projects, and internship opportunities for real-world application.
## What are the possible career paths after completing a B.A. (Hons) Psychology?
Graduates can work as:
 * Counsellors / Psychological Assistants
 * HR / Organizational Behaviour Specialists
 * Research Assistants or Data Analysts
 * Social Welfare / Community Mental Health Workers
 * Pursue higher studies (M.A / M.Sc in psychology specializations).

## What is the eligibility to enroll in this programme?
Students must have completed 10+2 (senior secondary) from a recognized board. Any stream (Science/Commerce/Arts) is usually accepted.
138.title: School of Liberal Arts

139.content:
## What is the eligibility to enroll in this programme?
Students must have completed 10+2 (senior secondary) from a recognized board. Any stream (Science/Commerce/Arts) is usually accepted.
## What subjects / topics are taught in General Psychology at GD Goenka University?
Key subjects include:
 * Introduction to Psychology & Biopsychology
 * Research Methods & Statistics
 * Developmental Psychology
 * Social Psychology
 * Abnormal Psychology
 * Counseling Psychology / Psychological Interventions
 * Electives, practicals, projects, and internship components.

## What is the duration of the course?
The B.A. (Hons) Psychology programme is structured over 4 years (8 semesters). Some universities offer 3-year versions, but GD Goenka University follows a 4-year model.
139.title: School of Liberal Arts

140.content:
## What are the learning outcomes of this programme?
By graduation, students are expected to:
 * Understand evolution of psychology as a science, major theories and domains.
 * Apply psychological concepts across contexts: lifespan, social, clinical, etc.
 * Get familiar with psychological tools of assessment and research methodologies.
 * Develop ethical, professional, and communication skills.
 * Be ready for higher studies or entry-level roles in counselling, HR, social work, research assistance etc.

## I am serious about becoming a Chef and opening my own restaurant – what’s the best course for me?
We recommend the Grand Diplôme® for comprehensive training in Cuisine and Pâtisserie.
If you prefer to specialise in just one discipline, choose the Diplôme de Cuisine or the Diplôme de Pâtisserie.
Our Grand Diplôme®, Diplôme de Cuisine and Diplôme de Pâtisserie can be followed by the Diploma in Culinary Management, covering advanced cooking techniques, and supported with a diverse range of management skills required within the food business world.
Le Cordon Bleu London created a suite of integrated programmes comprising Le Cordon Bleu culinary arts diplomas with culinary management. Each programme can either be studied in 12 months or in 15 months. In the latter, students would undertake a 3-month internship

The intensive diplomas are designed to include a complete diploma course within a six month period. They offer the same progressive classical foundation, with the Basic and Intermediate levels completed within the first three-month term. The Superior level is then completed through a further three months of study.
It is not possible to study intensive diplomas in Cuisine and Pâtisserie at the same time. However, you can still receive the Grand Diplôme® by taking both the diplomas separately.

## What does “Cordon Bleu” mean?
In the 16th century, King Henry III created one of the most important orders in France, “L’Ordre du Saint-Esprit.” Symbolizing this order was the cross of the Holy Spirit which hung on a blue ribbon or un cordon bleu. Due to the prestigious nature of this Order and the decadent feasts accompanying their ceremonies, the name Cordon Bleu became well recognized and celebrated.
“Cordon Bleu” has been associated with excellence in culinary education since the founding of the first Le Cordon Bleu school in Paris in 1895.

## How is a student's work marked?
Students are marked for each practical session they attend on standard criteria such as Culinary presentation, Culinary technique, Hygiene, Organisation, and Teamwork.
There is a final practical examination at the end of term for which it is compulsory to gain a pass.
For Diploma in Culinary Management and Diploma in Gastronomy Nutrition and Food Trends students take an additional examination for Food Hygiene Level 3 and are required to submit a final portfolio.
For Diploma in Wine, Gastronomy and Management students also take a level 2 Award for Personal Licence Holder.
The BBA Culinary Industry Management undergraduate degree consists of modular assessments which is a combination of coursework, written examinations, practical observations which are taken at the end of each term. Students will be provided with a detailed assessment criteria for each module.
If you have further questions, please do not hesitate to contact our team.
201.title: School of Hospitality & Tourism

202.content:
## What is the Level 2 Award in Food Safety in Catering?
At Basic level students are scheduled to attend the Level two Award in Food Safety in Catering.
This course is awarded by the Royal Society of Public Health and gives a thorough grounding in Food Hygiene. It is essential for those working in the food industry and of a general interest. This one-day course concludes with an examination, the successful completion of which leads to the award of the appropriate certificate.
The course is usually scheduled on the first or second day of term before students start working in the practical kitchens.
202.title: School of Hospitality & Tourism

203.content:
## Will my course be held in Bloomsbury or Fleet Street?
Le Cordon Bleu short courses can be held either in the Le Cordon Bleu London institute at 15 Bloomsbury Square, or in the workshop kitchen at Cord by Le Cordon Bleu, located at 85 Fleet Street.
The location of each short course is indicated alongside the session date and also within the email confirmation and communications.
All diploma programmes' classes almost always take place at the Bloomsbury Square institute and in the instance that a class may have to take place at our Fleet Street premises, students will be informed of this in advance.
## What is Le Cordon Bleu?
Le Cordon Bleu is a world-renowned international association of academic institutes, offering best culinary and hospitality-related education. It works in alliance with more than 35 academic institutes around the globe, one of them being GD Goenka University's School of Hospitality and Tourism.
203.title: School of Hospitality & Tourism

204.content:
## Do Hotel management courses offer placements and internships?
Students have access to internships and placement opportunities with leading luxury hotels, resorts, and renowned restaurant groups. Industry collaborations provide valuable hands-on experience and professional exposure, reinforcing GD Goenka University's reputation among the top hotel management colleges in Delhi NCR.
## What visa do I need for the integrated internship course in the UK?
Students undertaking the UK internship must obtain a valid visa that permits both study and work placement. Eligible students receive guidance on visa documentation and application procedures, ensuring a smooth international learning experience as part of their hotel management course.

## General
## What are the eligibility criteria to take admission in the five-year law courses?
As one of the prestigious BA LLB colleges in Gurgaon, GD Goenka University has the following prerequisites for admission: 1. You must qualify for your higher Secondary Exam from a recognised Education Board. 2. You will also require appearing for the Goenka Aptitude Test for Admission (GATA). 3. Once you clear the entrance examination, the admission authority will conduct a personal interview, after which your admission will conclude.
215.title: School of Law

216.content:
## What training programmes can you opt for by enrolling at the GD Goenka University, School of Law?
GD Goenka University offers multiple legal courses to students as one of the leading law colleges in Gurgaon. If you wish to pursue law after the 10+2 examination, you will have several choices under five-year legal programmes. For example, you can opt for BA-LLB (Hons), BBA-LLB (Hons) and B.Com-LLb (Hons). Conversely, you can join the three-year LLB courses after graduation in any subject. You can also choose to complete the one-year LLM (Masters of Law) from the GD Goenka University School of Law or opt for the PhD programme. Besides, the institute offers certificate courses as well. To know in detail, contact the university helpline number.
216.title: School of Law

217.content:
## How does GD Goenka University help law students excel in their careers?
GD Goenka University is recognised far and wide as the best law college in Gurgaon for its quality teaching and legal research. It has proficient teaching faculties that make difficult legal provisions and jurisprudential concepts easily understandable for the students. Also, the students learn through practical-oriented and problem-based projects. The college arranges regular moot court sessions, seminars and informal small group discussions to help the learners develop robust advocacy and communication skills, boosting their confidence. Besides, the court visits, internship opportunities and other debates and competitions contribute to the student's growth as a legal professional, helping them establish a successful legal career.
## Academics & Curriculum
217.title: School of Law

218.content:
## Academics & Curriculum
## Does the School offer specialization in LL.M.?
Yes, LL.M. students can choose specializations such as Corporate & Commercial Law, Intellectual Property Law, Constitutional & Administrative Law, Criminal Law, and more, depending on availability.
## Are internships compulsory?
Yes, internships are an integral part of the program. Students are placed with law firms, courts, corporate houses, NGOs, and government bodies to gain practical exposure.
## What makes the School of Law’s curriculum unique?
Our curriculum integrates law with business, humanities, and technology, ensuring a holistic legal education. It is regularly updated in consultation with industry experts, academicians, and leading practitioners.
## Admissions
## How can I apply for admission?
Applications can be submitted online through the University website. You will need to register, fill the application form, upload documents, and pay the application fee.
218.title: School of Law

219.content:
## What is the eligibility criteria for admission to the undergraduate law programs?
Candidates must have passed 10+2 or equivalent examination from a recognized board with at least 50% marks (45% for SC/ST). Admission is based on merit, GD Goenka University Entrance Exam (GATA), and a personal interview.
## What law programs does the School of Law offer?
We offer undergraduate (BA LL.B. (Hons.), BBA LL.B. (Hons.), LLB (Hons.)), postgraduate (LL.M.), and doctoral (Ph.D.) programs in Law, designed to meet global standards of legal education.
## Faculty & Infrastructure
## What facilities are available for law students?
We provide a state-of-the-art Moot Court Hall, Legal Aid Clinic, E-Library with national and international databases (Manupatra, SCC Online, HeinOnline, Westlaw, etc.), dedicated research centers, and modern classrooms equipped with ICT facilities.
219.title: School of Law

220.content:
## Who are the faculty members?
Our faculty comprises experienced academicians, legal practitioners, retired judges, and industry professionals who bring both academic rigor and practical insights to the classroom.
## Placements & Career Support
## What kind of career support is provided?
Our Career Development Cell (CDC) assists students with internships, placements, resume building, interview training, and networking opportunities with top law firms, corporates, and NGOs.
## Where do students get placed after graduation?
Graduates have secured placements in reputed law firms, corporate houses, LPOs, research institutions, and have also pursued higher education in leading Indian and foreign universities.
## Research & Extension Activities
## Are there opportunities for community service?
Yes, through our Legal Aid Clinic and outreach programs, students engage with real communities, providing legal awareness and pro bono services under faculty guidance.
220.title: School of Law

221.content:
## Does the School promote legal research?
Yes, we encourage research through dedicated centers such as the Centre for IP Studies, Centre for Criminal Law, and Environmental Law & Policy Centre. Students and faculty regularly publish in reputed journals.
## Student Life & Opportunities
## Are international opportunities available?
Yes, students can participate in exchange programs, summer schools, and conferences with partner universities abroad, enhancing global exposure.
## Are moot courts and legal competitions encouraged?
Absolutely. The School of Law actively trains and sends students to national and international moot courts, debates, mediation, and arbitration competitions.
## Does the School of Law have student-run societies?
Yes, students manage societies such as Moot Court Society, ADR Society, Debate & Literary Society, and the Social Media & Publication Team.

## At GD Goenka University, we recognize that education extends beyond classroom learning. Preparing students to excel in a rapidly evolving global environment requires a comprehensive ecosystem that blends academic excellence with practical industry exposure.
The Corporate Resource Center is driven by the vision of creating career-ready graduates equipped with industry-relevant knowledge, skills, and competencies. The Corporate Resource Center aims to bridge the gap between academic learning and industry expectations through structured initiatives, continuous engagement with corporate partners, and immersive skill-building programs.

#### Best Practices in Career Advancement
The CRC follows globally recognized best practices to ensure that students receive high-quality career services and training. These practices include personalized career counseling, structured employability enhancement programs, integrated learning approaches, and continuous feedback mechanisms.
 * Career Counseling and Guidance Framework – Personalized counseling sessions help students identify strengths, interests, and align career aspirations with academic pursuits.
 * Structured Employability Programs – Workshops, training modules, and interventions enhance technical and soft skills.
 * Integrated Learning – Internships, live projects, and case studies ensure industry exposure.
 * Continuous Feedback – Engagement with students, faculty, and recruiters refines training and placement strategies.

317.content:
#### Placement Process
 * 1 st
##### Recruitment Registration
All recruiters participating in final interviews must register with the CRC Department. Students are expected to follow the current placement policy, which may evolve based on industry trends and market needs.
 * 2 nd
##### Pre-Placement Presentation/Talks
Companies wishing to conduct Pre-Placement Talks (PPTs) should schedule them in coordination with the Placement Cell. These talks allow recruiters to provide detailed insights into their companies and the roles they offer.

390.content:
### Examination Support Services
The university ensures fair and accessible examination procedures for students with writing difficulties by providing or allowing the use of scribes. Additionally, extra time is granted to differently-abled students during exams to accommodate their needs. These provisions are in line with Government Circular ED 5 UNE 204 (dated 5.3.2004) and ED 5 UNE 2004 (dated 22.3.2004), which mandate the following guidelines:
 * #### Scribe Selection:
Blind students have the right to choose their scribe.
 * #### Additional Examination Time:
Physically disabled, blind, or hearing-impaired candidates, along with their scribes, are entitled to an extra 20 minutes per examination hour.
 * #### Qualification Criteria:
The scribe must have a qualification equal to or lower than the student, provided their academic background does not overlap with the examination subjects (e.g., a B.A. or M.A. graduates may serve as a scribe for a B.Sc. student).
390.title: Handicap Access

391.content:
### Examination Support Services

Recognising that hearing-impaired students may face language and grammatical challenges, their answer sheets are identified separately and evaluated with additional care to ensure fairness.

#### Shodhganga(INFLIBNET) A Reservoir Of Indian Theses
Library is Institutional member of Shodhganga. Shodhgangais the name coined to denote digital repository of Indian Electronic Theses and Dissertations set-up by the INFLIBNET Centre.
The word “Shodh” originates from Sanskrit and stands for research and discovery. The “Ganga” is the holiest, largest and longest of all rivers in Indian subcontinent. The Ganga is the symbol of India’s age-long culture and civilization, ever-changing, ever-flowing, ever-loved and revered by its people, and has held India’s heart captive and drawn uncounted millions to her banks since the dawn of history.
Shodhganga stands for the reservoir of Indian intellectual output stored in a repository hosted and maintained by the INFLIBNET Centre.

##### Academic
# Auditorium
### The auditorium at GD Goenka University is a space designed for connection, creativity, and learning. With modern technology in place, it’s perfect for everything from lectures and workshops, to conferences and cultural performances.
Equipped with high-quality sound systems, projectors, and wireless microphones, it ensures every event runs effortlessly.
The auditorium’s spacious design offers flexible seating, making it suitable for events of all sizes. Whether you're attending a small seminar or a larger conference, the view from every seat is clear, and the atmosphere is always comfortable. Air-conditioning, modern lighting, and accessibility are all part of creating an experience where everyone feels welcome.
Whether it's an academic session or a student performance, the auditorium is at the heart of campus life, bringing the university’s community together in meaningful ways.

420.content:
##### Research
# Overview
> The Research & Development department in the University was established in the year 2016 to promote high quality research in the University. It provides direction to the research endeavours of all stakeholders.
The University supports academic staff to develop high quality research proposals and tender for nationally and internationally competitive research grants and contract research projects funded by business corporations, not-for-profit organisations, industry associations and charitable organisations.
It also works with its international partners in research and research dissemination activities.The University’s research endeavours are through doctoral projects, competitive and contract research projects, research dissemination and research patents filed by faculty, staff and students and it fosters’ a research culture through provision of training and incentives.
420.title: Overview

421.content:
# Overview

The 'Research and Innovation Council' (URIC)oversees and directs the research activities at the University.
 * Faculty members are eligible to seek financial and in-kind support for research, consultancy and external engagement.
 * Research endeavours would be included in assessing the workload and contributions of faculty members. Research outcomes (such as success in grant applications, organizing research forums, scholarly publications in appropriately tiered academic journals, organizing research training activities etc) and professional contributions that would improve the University's esteem (editorship in appropriately tiered scholarly journals, appointments in national and international scholarly committees, membership in editorial board of appropriately tiered journals etc.)
 * Both in-house and external training would be offered to develop the research and research dissemination competencies and capabilities of faculty.
421.title: Overview

422.content:
# Overview

* Both in-house and external training would be offered to develop the research and research dissemination competencies and capabilities of faculty.
 * Academic staff would be offered support to organize Doctoral colloquia, engagement in scholar research advisory committees, participation in doctoral research committees, and support for participating in appropriately tiered national and international conferences and engaging with international partners in research endeavours.
 * The University also encourages continuous learning through professional development and advanced study.
 * Faculty are encouraged to undertake consultancy work and thereby develop linkages with industry. The University has instituted a Consultancy Policy.
 * Individual faculty or groups of faculty Members are encouraged to seek competitive grants from various funding agencies.
422.title: Overview

423.content:
# Overview

Research Scholars
The University conducts research seminars, conference and colloquia and the participation of the research scholars is encouraged in both in- house as well as external events. The University also aides the scholars in accessing the laboratory and library facilities of government and non-government organizations, in addition to usage of the University's facilities.
 * The University periodically organizes guest lectures by senior research professionals from various domains.
 * Scholars enrolled for PhD programs are guided by Supervisors. Progress is monitored by the 'Scholar Research Advisory Committee' as well as the 'Doctoral Research Committee'. All necessary support is provided to the scholars for completion of their research work.
423.title: Overview

424.content:
# Overview

Code of Ethics Committee
Code of Ethics Committee ensures that faculty as well as scholars pursuing research at the University maintains academic integrity that is required for the academic research following the professional standards including appropriate research design and frameworks, conforms to practices that govern research ethics and abides by the requirements set out by professional and regulatory research guidance and research ethics frameworks issued in appropriate areas.
**Research Support provided by R &D:**
 * Funded Projects
 * Consultancy Projects
 * Publications
 * Patents
424.title: Overview

425.content:
### The principal discipline clusters in GD Goenka University are medical and allied sciences, basic and applied sciences, agricultural sciences, Humanities & social sciences, communication and media, management, engineering, teacher education, law, hospitality, design and architecture.
Research activities take place across the University either in the form of doctoral research, competitively funded projects, contract research projects, projects in collaboration with international partners, research dissemination such as publications and patent applications and registrations, Masters & Bachelors research dissertations and other activities undertaken by faculty and students.
The University encourages, supports and incentivizes academic staff and students to engage intensely in research, research dissemination and teaching-learning engagements that are informed by research.
425.title: Overview

GD Goenka University is a leading multidisciplinary University which fosters a culture of enquiry driven by passionate academicians and students. Research and academic programs at the University are driven by outstanding faculty, many of whom are reputed for their research contributions internationally. GDGoenka University has strong collaborations with leading Indian industries and International institutions resulting in robust research focused academic tracks and opportunities for collaborative research.

Interdisciplinary projects are a part of the University’s curriculum enabling the students to address complex, real-world challenges, resulting in the publication of the work in leading journals, incubation ideas and patents. The University offers a progressive research promotion policy enabling and empowering faculty to make strides into innovative areas of enquiry and intellectual curiosity while motivating them through recognition and celebration of their endeavors. Intra and extramural funding, consultancy assignments and seed grants, Innovation and patent, publication are covered under the scope of the policy.

The faculty and students at GDGoenka University are committed to creating long term social impacts and are working towards technological and theoretical advancements for the betterment of local, regional and national communities.

## Vision
To be an institution of international repute for fostering a culture of enquiry and knowledge creation through cutting edge multidisciplinary research and innovation, promoting industry-academia collaborations, generating intellectual property, publications, patents and products that meet the needs of the global community focused on sustainable development and enhance global competitiveness.
432.title: Overview

433.content:
## Our Mission
 * To encourage dynamic and multi-disciplinary research ecosystem in the University by promoting the research of both fundamental and translational potential.
 * To assist collaborations among researchers and industry to develop culture of research.
 * To make interdisciplinary learning exciting through integrative teaching strategies driven by curiosity and creativity.
 * To promote creativity and innovation through experiential research.
 * To train and prepare researchers focused on ethical practices.
 * To promote product and technology development for societal needs and sustainable development.
 * To encourage generation of extra-mural funding, quality publications in peer-reviewed journals, patents and product development.

496.content:
### GD Goenka University has a vision to be a global leader and enable all its stakeholders to be engaged in research, innovation and entrepreneurial pursuits.
The whole world in the era of knowledge economy is looking at India as a knowledge partner. Above all India has set a target to be a self-reliant (atma-nirbhar) nation. Further as a university, whose very definition involves knowledge creation, comprehension and dissemination has to be in the forefront of creative pursuits and provide a conducive environment for research and innovation. To effectively protect such intellectual capital, it is critical that the university has a well-defined IP policy both for securing its knowledge capital as also incentivising the stakeholders in the system.
496.title: IPR Cell

497.content:
### GD Goenka University has a vision to be a global leader and enable all its stakeholders to be engaged in research, innovation and entrepreneurial pursuits.

The scope of IPR is not just limited to science and technology but all faculties on the campus, such as Commerce & Management, Humanities, Science and Technology and Interdisciplinary Studies. In view of this and considering the importance of formally protecting the intellectual property of the faculties, staff and students, the university has established an IPR cell.
The importance of IPR for universities has been highlighted through its weightage in NIRF ranking, NAAC and NBA accreditation process.
The purpose of the IPR cell is to facilitate, encourage, promote and safeguard scientific inquiry, research pursuits and the academic freedom of its faculties, researchers and students. IPR cell conducts activities to provide a clear understanding of the rights and responsibilities of the faculty, staff and students to protect their intellectual properties generated through research work.
497.title: IPR Cell

498.content:
## ! IPR Policy of GD Goenka University
IPR cell is working towards creating an innovative culture which fosters the creation of IP and development of IPR at the University. GD Goenka University has a well-defined IPR policy and has established procedure for converting the knowledge generated to wealth. The IPR cell ensures the speedy processing and filling of applications for patents, designs, copyrights etc.
498.title: IPR Cell

499.content:
### Functions of IPR cell
 * To create awareness and guide the faculty, staff and students of GD Goenka University on the importance of IPR.
 * To disseminate knowledge on patents, patent regime in India and abroad and its registration aspects.
 * To work on enabling and supporting technology/IP transfer and commercialization of granted IPRs.
 * To motivate innovators to come up with new ideas and help them to protect the innovation.
 * To enable IP Policy adoption and implementation at the university.
 * To manage IPR of GD Goenka University.
 * To conduct Workshops, Seminars and Training courses on IPR.
499.title: IPR Cell

500.content:
### Procedure for filing IPR in GD Goenka University
Inventors submit the Invention disclosure form (IDF) to IPR Cell with request to file an IP. The said application is processed in following manner:
##### For Supported Invention
 * Administrative approval of GD Goenka University.
 * Filing of IP through IPR Cell, GD Goenka University.
 * Procedure at Patent Office
 * Commercialization of Innovation and Revenue Generation

##### For Incidental Invention
 * Administrative approval of GD Goenka University.
 * Rights sharing agreement between GD Goenka University and Inventor.
 * or NOC from GD Goenka University.
 * Accordingly, filing of IP.

##### Admissions
# FAQs
What programmes are offered at GD Goenka University?
GD Goenka University offers a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programmes across various disciplines, including Engineering, Law, Management, Design, Hospitality, Humanities, Education, Agricultural Sciences, and Medical and Allied Health Sciences.
What is the admission process at GD Goenka University?
The admission process involves filling out the online application form, uploading relevant documents, submitting valid scores of national-level entrance exams (if applicable), followed by a personal interview (PI) for select courses.
Is there an application fee?
Yes, the application fee is ₹1,003 (non-refundable), which can be paid online through debit card, credit card, UPI, or net banking at the time of form submission.
What documents are required at the time of application?
Applicants must submit the following documents:
 * Passport-sized photograph
 * Scanned signature
575.title: FAQs

576.content:
# FAQs

What documents are required at the time of application?
Applicants must submit the following documents:
 * Passport-sized photograph
 * Scanned signature
 * Class 10 and 12 mark sheets
 * Graduation transcripts (for PG applicants)
 * Valid ID proof (Aadhaar/passport)
 * Competitive exam results (if applicable)
576.title: FAQs

577.content:
# FAQs

What are the eligibility criteria for undergraduate programmes?
For most UG programmes, students must have completed Class 12 or equivalent with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks. You can check for eligibility requirements on our course pages to know more.
Is GD Goenka University recognised and accredited?
Yes, GD Goenka University is recognised by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and accredited by the Bar Council of India (BCI), Council of Architecture (COA), Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), and other statutory bodies, depending on the programme.
Is there an entrance exam conducted by GD Goenka University?
No, GD Goenka University does not conduct its own entrance exam. However, scores from recognised national-level entrance tests such as JEE, CUET, CLAT, CAT, MAT, or NID/NIFT are accepted wherever applicable. Direct admissions based on merit are also offered in many programmes.
Are scholarships available?
577.title: FAQs

578.content:
# FAQs

Are scholarships available?
Yes, GD Goenka University offers merit-based scholarships, early admission incentives, and financial aid. Scholarships are awarded based on academic performance, competitive exam scores, and other qualifying criteria.
Can international students apply to GD Goenka University?
Absolutely. International applicants must submit equivalent academic credentials, English proficiency scores (such as IELTS, TOEFL, or PTE), and a valid passport. The International Admissions Cell assists with every step of the process.
What are the key deadlines for admission?
Admissions are conducted on a rolling basis, with early applications encouraged due to limited seat availability. Typically, applications open in January. Specific deadlines are announced on the website.
Does the university accept CUET scores?
Yes, GD Goenka University accepts CUET (UG/PG) scores for several programmes as part of its merit-based admission process.
578.title: FAQs

579.content:
# FAQs

Does the university accept CUET scores?
Yes, GD Goenka University accepts CUET (UG/PG) scores for several programmes as part of its merit-based admission process.
Are hostel and accommodation facilities available?
Yes, GD Goenka University offers on-campus residential facilities for both male and female students, with options ranging from shared to single rooms. All hostels are equipped with AC, Wi-Fi, dining, laundry, and round-the-clock security.
What support is available for applicants during the admissions process?
Applicants receive full support from the university’s admission counsellors, both online and over call, throughout the application process—from course selection and form filling to documentation and final offer letters.
Are there any lateral entry options?
579.title: FAQs

580.content:
# FAQs

Are there any lateral entry options?
Yes, lateral entry is permitted in select programmes such as B.Tech, BCA, and diploma-to-degree transitions, subject to eligibility and prior academic background. Connect with our admissions team to find out more about the lateral entry.
Is there an option to defer my admission to the next academic session?
Yes, deferment may be granted in select cases due to medical, personal, or visa-related reasons. Students must make a formal request and it will be reviewed by the admissions team.
How do I get updates about my application status?
Once you apply, you will receive login credentials for the GD Goenka University admission portal, where you can track your application progress, interview schedule and offer letter status in real time.
Is there any counselling or career guidance provided during admissions?
580.title: FAQs

581.content:
# FAQs

Is there any counselling or career guidance provided during admissions?
Yes, GD Goenka University offers personalised counselling to help students choose the right course based on their interests, career goals, and academic background. Career counsellors are available online, over call, and in-person on campus.
Do I need to visit the campus for admission?
No, the entire admission process from application to offer letter can be completed online. However, students are welcome to visit the campus for counselling, open days, or personal guidance.
Are industry certifications integrated into academic programmes?
Yes, several programmes include industry certifications, practical training modules, and live projects in collaboration with global academic and industry partners to enhance real-world learning.
581.title: FAQs

626.title: Student Exchange Programmes

627.content:
## Semester Exchange Programmes
> GD Goenka University’s semester exchange programmes open doors to academic and cultural experiences with top global universities.
We help you to choose from a variety of destinations to find the one that best complements your field of study and personal aspirations. With expert guidance from your academic advisor and the International Student Office, you’ll ensure a seamless transition of credits and make the most of this immersive international experience.
### Key Application Requirements:
 * Completed Exchange Student Application Form and Nomination Form
 * Updated CV [(Europass format)](), Passport Copy, and Academic Transcript
 * Departmental Approval (No backlogs; CGPA may be considered)
 * As a student, you’ll receive support at every step, from securing your visa and accommodation to health insurance and on-campus academics at your destination.

Incoming Internship Exchange Programmes
627.title: Student Exchange Programmes

628.content:
## Incoming Internship Exchange Programmes
> Elevate your professional skills with an internship exchange programme through GD Goenka University’s partner institutions.
Specifically tailored to your academic field and career goals, these internships offer hands-on learning opportunities across international settings. You'll work alongside industry leaders, gain invaluable skills, insights and a global perspective that will set you apart.
628.title: Student Exchange Programmes

629.content:
### Key Application Requirements:
 * Completed Internship Student Application Form and Nomination Form
 * CV, Passport Copy, and Transcript (Grade Card)
 * Departmental Approval (No backlogs; CGPA may be considered)
 * With full support from our International Student Office, including visa, travel arrangements and health insurance, you’ll be set to make the most of your international internship journey.
629.title: Student Exchange Programmes

630.content:
### Key Application Requirements:

GD Goenka University welcomes internship exchange students from all across the world. Choosing Gd Goenka University as your next destination as an exchange student can be beneficial due to our Global Network, high quality of education, our vibrant campus with both academic and extracurricular facilities including an olympic swimming pool and an advanced fitness center, as well as our cosmopolitan campus where you can embrace a multicultural atmosphere where students from different backgrounds come together to share their perspectives, cultures, and experiences, fostering mutual understanding and lifelong connections. Experience the warmth of our community, the richness of our academic programs, and the transformative power of international education. Together, let’s build a future where boundaries are overcome, cultures unite, and dreams come to life.
630.title: Student Exchange Programmes

## All of our courses are taught in English and we provide transcripts in US and ECTS credits. We have an English Foundation Program for the students coming from non-English speaking countries.
> Designed and delivered by English language experts, the programme serves as a special training platform for the students (especially for foreign students with limited knowledge of English language) to refine their proficiency in the language.
655.title: English Foundation Programme

656.content:
### Program Module
#### 01
Improve English Proficiency
#### 02
IT Skill Enhancement
#### 03
Personality Development
#### 04
Understanding Of Indian Culture
##### 6 Months Course
This programme is for beginners who have little knowledge of the English language. The 6-month course finely works towards building language skills in students through a very basic step to step approach. The classes are supplemented with preparation for academic reading and writing skills for students to help in their university courses. The classes are held five days a week with a total of 25 hours of study and practice per week.
##### 3 Months Course
The 3-month programme is an intensive course designed exclusively for those learners who require advanced English-learning skills. The objective of the course is to provide a finishing touch to students, aiding them to gain proficiency and fluency in language skills. The classes are held five days a week for a total of 25 hours of study and practice per week.

664.content:
##### Campus Life
# Safety on Campus
> At GD Goenka University, creating a secure and welcoming environment is part of our promise to students, allowing everyone to feel comfortable, learn, and truly thrive.
Our campus has an extensive CCTV network that covers key areas, with central monitoring to respond swiftly if needed. For safe, stress-free travel, we also provide RFID-equipped buses for our day-students, ensuring a smooth ride every day across Delhi NCR.
‹›
> Our security team is present 24/7, with trained guards actively monitoring classrooms, corridors, and busy areas.
Female guards are stationed at select locations to help maintain a safe, inclusive environment across campus. Entry is tightly controlled with biometric readers, modern IP cameras, and regular security patrols, along with checkpoints at the main gate to prevent unauthorized access.
664.title: Safety on Campus

##### Campus Life
# Events & Celebrations
##### A Life Worth Living
GD Goenka University, in its vision of Foundation to Flight, believes that the holistic development of the individual begins with active involvement in activities beyond academics.
It is towards this end that the University constitutes a number of student bodies that engages the students, and also gives them a platform to perform on an international stage.
## Campus USPs
Life at GD Goenka University is shaped not only by the campus you live on, but by the people who live here with you.
State Of An Art College Infrastructure Which Facilitates Learning & Growth
Holistic Well Being & Development For Enhanced Performance
Academics Excellence With 99% Of On Campus Placement Assistance
717.title: Events & Celebrations

718.content:
## GD Goenka Orientation
GD Goenka University has a well-organized Orientation program where students are introduced to their respective Schools, faculty members, coordinators, and the teaching and learning methodology being followed at the respective school level. The students are also introduced to the course plan, timetable, and credit requirements of each course by the concerned faculty of each department.
The orientation also includes an interactive session organized exclusively for parents, during which they interact with the leadership team of GD Goenka University.
#### Transcend Farewell
Transcend is the farewell party that is organized for all pass outs every year. As the name suggests, transcend is a final fun event at the university for all graduates as they embark on their future endeavors.
The circle of campus life comes full this day as juniors now give farewell to the seniors who had once welcomed them on campus.
718.title: Events & Celebrations

719.content:
#### Convocation
Convocation is a yearly event where graduating students are felicitated with their degrees/diplomas.
The convocation ceremony at GD Goenka University also sees the felicitation of meritorious students with the GopinathGoenka Gold Medals, Convocations at the University have always seen eminent personalities from the state/nation gracing the occasion.
#### Reva Freshers
REVA, The Fresher’s Fest of the University was held with great energy and enthusiasm on 27 September 2025. The day saw an incredible show of zest and energy as talented freshers across the university came on stage vying for the prestigious trophy of Mr. and Miss Fresher.
#### Annual Fest
The Annual Fest of GD Goenka University is a yearly mega event with three components—the Techno-cultural aspect covered in Acceleron, Sporting events covered in Sportopia,and Innovation and Entrepreneurship component titled Idea. The event concludes every year with a DJ Night and a Celebrity Performance.
719.title: Events & Celebrations

The University celebrates the 1st of July as its foundation day. It was on this day, back in 2013, that under the trail-blazing leadership of Hon’ble Chairman, Shri A. K. Goenka, the GD Goenka Group forayed into education and launched a university par excellence, imbibing the best teaching practices of the world, creating a new vista of learning that catered not only to India but to the world. The day also sees distinguished faculty and staff being felicitated and recognized through the Star Performer Awards.

##### No Smoking Day
The NSS Unit of GD Goenka University marked No Smoking Day with a unique initiative where an attempt was made to reach out to the university community of students and sensitize them to the ill effects and dangers of smoking. A pamphlet spreading awareness on the issue was circulated with all the students on campus through an email on 13 March 2024. Additionally, an anonymous questionnaire was also floated among the students on the campus which was self-reflecting in nature and tried to understand the motivations/influences on the youth which pushes them towards smoking. The findings of this questionnaire will be used in further events to address the issue from the perspective of the youth.
##### National Vaccination Day
760.title: National Service Scheme

761.content:

##### National Vaccination Day
The NSS unit in collaboration with the Department of Public Health, observed National Vaccination Day with an Immunization Awareness Workshop on 16 March 2024. This workshop was aligned with Sustainable Development Goal 3, which aims to ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages. The resource person for the workshop was Dr. Shipra Singh, Masters in Public Health and Dr. Pranava Prakash, Head of the Department of Public Health. The Workshop was a successful initiative in promoting vaccination education and advocacy. By addressing common misconceptions and providing accurate information about immunization, the workshop contributed to the broader goal of achieving universal health coverage and promoting good health for all.
##### World Health Day

##### World Health Day
The NSS Unit celebrated World Health Day with a week-long series of events. On 07 April 2024, a webinar titled "Sexual Well-Being in Youth" was held, led by Tanisha Gaurav, BAJMC, Batch 2022-2025, from the School of Media & Entertainment. This engaging session allowed students to discuss various aspects of the topic. Continuing the celebration, on 10 April 2024, the NSS Unit organized a meditation workshop for faculty, staff, and students. Health advisors Ms. Monica Datta and Ms. Gurpreet Sethi from the Heartfulness Institute conducted the workshop, explaining the importance of meditation and guiding participants through a meditation session. The week's events also included an interactive session where faculty and students discussed stress-related concerns, addressing both the physical and emotional aspects of stress.
##### International Yoga Day

##### International Yoga Day
International Yoga Day was celebrated with great enthusiasm at GD Goenka University on 21 June 2024. The NSS Unit organized a special yoga and meditation session for faculty, staff and students who gathered in the campus courtyard to ambient music and mood. The resource people for the day were Dr. Vijata Arya, Yoga-Naturopathy Doctor and Managing Director at Kayakalp Yoga Prakritik Chikitsalaya, Sohna Gurugram, and Brahmakumari, Sister Alka, Meditation Specialist and Public Speaker. The day started with a yoga session led by Dr. Vijata who enlightened the audience with the power of yoga and the process of reaching one’s inner self through it. The session came to an end with a relaxing guided meditation session under the supervision of Sister Alka. The day was a befitting celebration of India’s ancient knowledge.

The NSS unit of GD Goenka University organized Yuvamanthan MUN themed on India @2047 with the sub-theme 'Lifestyle for Environment.' ##### National Voters Day
The NSS Unit of GD Goenka University in collaboration with the Electoral Club organized a workshop on the Electoral Process to commemorate the National Voters Day, as also 75 years of the Election Commission of India on 25 January 2024. The workshop was facilitated by officials from the Election Commission of India as also dignitaries from the Haryana Administration which included IAS Mr. Hitesh Kumar Meena, Additional Deputy Commissioner, Gurugram & Mr. Gaurav Singh, Additional Chief Executive Officer, District Gurugram. The theme for this Voters Day, ‘Nothing like voting, I vote for sure’, truly resonated through the workshop which saw enthusiastic participation by students as they interacted with the officials. The day also saw a live demo of the EVM Machines and a dispelling of myths surrounding the process, which served as further encouragement to the participating audiences.

##### Republic Day
GD Goenka University celebrated with great gusto the 75th Republic Day of India on 26 January 2024. The atmosphere was rife with a spirit of patriotism as the National Flag of India was hoisted by the Dean Student Welfare & International Relations, Prof. (Dr.) Tanuja Kaushik in the presence of dignitaries from the University administration and student volunteers from the BSA and the NSS unit of GD Goenka University. The flag hoisting was followed with a speech by Dr. Kaushik, who shared words of wisdom regarding the significance of this day and the implementation of the Indian constitution that this day marks. The day saw cultural performances by Reverie, the Dance Club, of BSA Techno-Cultural. The celebrations came to an end with the distribution of sweets.

The NSS Unit of GD Goenka University marked World Earth Day on 22 April 2024 with a unique initiative that saw them repurposing old, used plastic containers to make colorful water feeders for birds. Groups of volunteers sat down to make a working model out of plastic bottles which were then placed on tree branches and filled with water. The initiative truly resonated with the theme of World Earth Day this year, ‘Plastics vs Planet’. Through the mindful activity, the NSS Unit truly showed their duty and understanding towards the planet and their world.

The NSS Unit of GD Goenka University observed World NGO Day on 27 February 2024 in collaboration with Navjyoti India Foundation in an event themed around water, sanitation and hygiene in Ghamroj. In a collective display of unity and service to the community the team raised awareness around the theme of “Empowerment through Education and Creativity on Water, Sanitation and Hygiene”, taking a spirited rally through the village, meeting the local population, raising awareness on hygiene and understanding the concerns of the local populace regarding water issues. ##### International Women’s Day
The NSS unit of GD Goenka University organized a panel discussion on March 8, 2024, themed "Women in Business: Advantages, Challenges & Opportunities." The event featured a TED talk by Sheryl Sandberg on "Why we have too few women leaders," sparking a lively discussion among students on the unique challenges women face in the corporate world. The students also brainstormed ways to address these challenges, reflecting on the existence of glass ceilings and highlighting successful women entrepreneurs. ##### Blood Donation Camp
The NSS Unit of GD Goenka University organized a Blood Donation Camp on 20 March 2024 in collaboration with the Indian Red Cross Society. The Red Cross Society was headed by Dr. Parv Kalra and a team of medical attendants. The camp saw enthusiastic participation by students, faculties and staff who came forward to donate for the noble cause in large numbers. The camp saw the collection of a record number of 84 units of blood. The NSS volunteers were felicitated with a certificate of appreciation by the Red Cross Society for their dedication and hard work. The event is co-related to UN SDG Goal 3, Good Health & Well Being.

##### Drug Awareness Workshop
The Proctorial Board, in collaboration with the NSS Unit and the Student Council, organized an awareness session on the harmful effects of drugs on 5 April 2024. Resource persons for the event included Shri Dilip Robidas, Assistant Director, and Shri Hardeep, Superintendent, from the Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB), Delhi Zone. They addressed the students on the harmful effects of drugs on the body and mind, reasons for the increase in youth drug consumption, signs of abuse, and the economic and psychological costs. #### Course Fee8.50 Lakhs
#### B.Tech. Civil Engineering with specialization in Smart Infrastructures is an undergraduate program designed to provide students with a deep understanding of civil engineering principles and practices, with a particular emphasis on the emerging field of smart infrastructures.
This program prepares students to design and manage complex infrastructural systems that leverage technology and data to improve efficiency, sustainability, and user experience. The program covers core civil engineering subjects such as mechanics, materials science, surveying, structural analysis, and geotechnical engineering, along with specialized courses in smart infrastructure, data analysis, and computer-aided design. Students also gain hands- on experience with the latest software tools and technologies used in the industry.
The curriculum includes courses such as smart city technologies, internet of things (IoT), machine learning, data analysis, and geospatial technologies.

Are there opportunities for community service?
Yes, through our Legal Aid Clinic and outreach programs, students engage with real communities, providing legal awareness and pro bono services under faculty guidance.
Who are the faculty members?
Our faculty comprises experienced academicians, legal practitioners, retired judges, and industry professionals who bring both academic rigor and practical insights to the classroom.
What facilities are available for law students?
We provide a state-of-the-art Moot Court Hall, Legal Aid Clinic, E-Library with national and international databases (Manupatra, SCC Online, HeinOnline, Westlaw, etc.), dedicated research centers, and modern classrooms equipped with ICT facilities.
Are moot courts and legal competitions encouraged?
Absolutely. The School of Law actively trains and sends students to national and international moot courts, debates, mediation, and arbitration competitions.

Are international opportunities available?
Candidates must have passed 10+2 or equivalent examination from a recognized board with at least 50% marks (45% for SC/ST). Admission is based on merit, Clat Score, and a personal interview.

How does GD Goenka University help law students excel in their careers?
GD Goenka University is recognised far and wide as the best law college in Gurgaon for its quality teaching and legal research. It has proficient teaching faculties that make difficult legal provisions and jurisprudential concepts easily understandable for the students. The course is a 2-year full-time postgraduate programme divided into four semesters, with each semester spanning six months.
The programme is designed to help students with advanced knowledge and practical insights into sustainable agricultural practices. It focuses on developing solutions that support environmental well-being while ensuring food security for a growing population.
Students gain expertise in modern agricultural techniques and learn to effectively communicate their ideas with farmers, researchers, and industry professionals. With the increasing demand for sustainable farming solutions, this field offers strong career opportunities across both government and private sectors.

996.content:
#### The BCA in Cyber Security is a specialized undergraduate program designed to address the increasing demand for professionals capable of safeguarding digital infrastructure.

The program focuses on protecting systems, networks, and data from cyber threats, attacks, and vulnerabilities. It provides in-depth knowledge of network security, ethical hacking, cryptography, digital forensics, cloud security, and risk management. Students gain practical experience through cyber labs, simulation of real-world attacks, and hands-on training in security tools such as Wireshark, Metasploit, and Kali Linux. The curriculum also includes topics on cyber laws, data privacy, and regulatory frameworks to ensure a comprehensive understanding of legal and ethical aspects of cybersecurity. Students are trained to identify vulnerabilities, conduct penetration testing, implement security protocols, and respond to cyber incidents effectively. The program encourages critical thinking and proactive defense strategies to combat evolving cyber threats

With state-of-the-art labs, industry collaborations and emphasis on ethical practice and emerging technologies (DNA profiling, toxicology, cyber forensics), the program ensures global acceptability and relevance in an increasingly complex forensic landscape. Graduates emerge as competent experts ready for high-stakes environments, contributing to truth-seeking, justice delivery, and scientific advancement worldwide.

#### Frequently Asked Questions
What are the minimum eligibility requirements for admission to the BBA LL.B. course?
 * Candidates must have passed 10+2 (any stream: Commerce, Arts, Science) from a recognized board.
 * A minimum of 50% aggregate marks is generally required.
 * Students appearing for their Class 12 final exams can also apply (subject to results).

Is an entrance exam mandatory for admission to BBA LL.B.?
 * Admission can be based on merit in 12th marks and/or personal interview conducted by GD Goenka University.
 * National-level tests like CLAT, LSAT–India, or CUET (UG) scores may also be considered.
1073.title: BBA LL.B (Hons.)

1074.content:
#### Frequently Asked Questions

What subjects or areas of study are covered in the BBA LL.B. curriculum?
The programme integrates **Law** with **Business & Management**
 * **Law Subjects** Constitutional Law, Contract Law, Criminal Law, Family Law, Property Law, Company Law, International Law, Environmental Law, Arbitration, etc.
 * **Business & Management Subjects** Principles of Management, Financial Accounting, Marketing, Business Communication, Human Resource Management, Economics, Strategic Management.
 * **Skill-based Training** Moot courts, internships, legal writing, drafting, client counseling.

How do I apply for the BBA LL.B. (5-Year) course?
 * Visit the GD Goenka University admission portal.
 * Register with basic details and create a profile.
 * Fill in academic and personal details.
 * Upload required documents (Class 10 & 12 marksheets, ID proof, etc.).
 * Pay the application fee and submit.
 * Appear for interview/counseling if required.
1074.title: BBA LL.B (Hons.)

1075.content:
#### Frequently Asked Questions

What documents are required at the time of admission?
 * **Class 10 and 12 marksheets & certificates**
 * **Proof of date of birth** (10th certificate or birth certificate)
 * **Government ID proof** (Aadhar/Passport, etc.)
 * **Passport-size photographs**
 * **Transfer/migration certificate** (if from another board/university)

Are there scholarships or financial aid options for BBA LL.B. students?
Yes. GD Goenka University offers:
 * Merit-based scholarships (based on Class 12 marks or entrance exam scores).
 * Need-based financial support for deserving students.
 * Students can also apply for government scholarships and private fellowships in law education.

Is there a minimum attendance requirement in the BBA LL.B. course?
 * Yes. Students must maintain 75% attendance in every subject to be eligible for exams, as per Bar Council of India (BCI) guidelines.

#### Program Structure
The Ph.D. in Psychology at GD Goenka University is a full-time/part-time research-intensive program conducted in two key phases:
##### Coursework Phase
As per UGC regulations, scholars must complete coursework for a duration of 6 months to one year, including training in research methodology, research ethics, and domain-specific inquiry. Upon successful completion, candidates move to the research phase.

Following approval of the research proposal by the SRAC (Scholar’s Research Advisory Committee) candidates engage in supervised original research. Regular progress evaluations, academic publications, and final thesis submission form key milestones during this phase.

#### Duration2 Years

#### Environmental engineering is a subfield of engineering that is concerned with the protection and preservation of the environment and environmental resources as well as the protection of populations from environmental threats.
Environmental engineers study water & waste treatment, solid waste management and monitor air and water quality. Students of this discipline will also study techniques for reducing environmental pollution and combating the effects of global warming among many other topics.
The objective of the program is to provide graduates from diverse disciplinary backgrounds with a detailed understanding of the most current and emerging concepts of sustainability and a high level of applied environmental knowledge and skills.
1360.title: M.Tech Environmental Engineering

1361.content:
#### Program Specialisation
Further-more it is an objective to facilitate the development of high levels of self-learning and self-evaluation. These competencies are intended prepare candidates to take up positions of leadership where they would have specific responsibility for environmental performance.
The program is not intended to produce environmental specialists but rather to equip professionals with the most current information, awareness, knowledge and understanding of how to optimally manage environmental factors while sustaining and enhancing society.
1361.title: M.Tech Environmental Engineering

1362.content:
#### Program Specialisation

Environmental engineering has immense scope in India for professionals who are qualified in chemical, biological, thermal, radioactive or even mechanical engineering as environmental engineering is a diverse field and requires people from diverse background. Moreover, professionals from process engineering, environmental chemistry, water and sewage treatment, waste reduction management, pollution prevention, etc are required in large numbers.
1362.title: M.Tech Environmental Engineering

1363.content:
#### Program Specialisation

Job prospects for professionals with qualification in environmental engineering are bright in research centres, NGOs and various governmental departments working towards green development. Candidates with M.Tech in environmental engineering have opportunities to work for government built assessment committees which study and analyse the environmental risks involved in certain projects. The report of such a committee is then submitted to the concerned authority for further observation. Scholars with PhD in environmental engineering can opt for teaching jobs in colleges and universities.

Graduates of the B.Optometry program are well-equipped to enter the eye care industry with a wide range of job opportunities, including:

#### The Master of Optometry is a 2-year postgraduate program aimed at providing advanced knowledge and clinical expertise in specialized areas of optometry.
This program is ideal for graduates who wish to deepen their understanding of complex visual disorders, engage in research, and take on leadership roles in the field.
The curriculum includes modules on ocular diagnostics, binocular vision therapy, low vision rehabilitation, contact lens practice, public health optometry, and evidence-based clinical practice. Students also undertake a research project or dissertation under expert guidance, preparing them for academic, research, and advanced clinical roles.
Through access to the university’s modern labs and eye clinic, students refine their clinical decision-making and diagnostic abilities. They also benefit from seminars, workshops, guest lectures, and opportunities for collaboration with national and international institutions.

#### Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) with specialization in Internet of Things (IoT) integrates core ECE concepts with modern IoT technologies to develop smart, connected systems.
The program focuses on designing, developing, and managing intelligent devices and communication networks that enable seamless interaction between physical and digital environments. It emphasizes practical learning, innovation, and industry-oriented skills to meet the growing demand for IoT professionals.

#### Program Specialisation
1511.title: B.Tech Electronics and Communication Engineering

#### Program Highlights
 * Designed in alignment with emerging trends in IoT, Industry 5.0, and smart technologies.
 * Focus on real-time applications such as smart homes, smart cities, healthcare, industrial automation and sustainable development.
 * Strong foundation in electronics, communication, embedded systems, and networking.
 * Integration of hardware and software for intelligent system design.
 * Industry interaction through expert lectures, workshops, internships, and live projects.
 * Emphasis on data analytics, cloud integration, and cybersecurity in IoT.

Our program is designed to provide you with extensive industry-relevant exposure, including:

 * Industry Tools & Technologies: Working with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, IoT protocols (MQTT, HTTP), and wireless communication technologies.
