### Commercial Pilot License
In the 4th year, the student will have to study and take flight lessons in the Flight School to get the CPL (Commercial Pilot License) in the flying school in the USA from the FAA. At the end of this once the student gets the CPL then he or she also graduates both as an Aerospace Engineer and as a Pilot. The courses that the student takes in the flying school are counted toward their credits for earning an Aerospace Engineering Degree. Hence, at the end of 4 years, the student gets both an Aerospace Engineering Degree and their CPL license to fly.
1550.title: B.Tech Aerospace Engineering with Pathway to Pilot Program

1551.content:
### Airport Transport Pilot License
In addition, the student can extend for another 18 months more to do a 6-month flying internship and the student will be paid for the internship as per the number of hours the student flies. Then at the end of the six months, the student will have to take job offers and keep flying to accumulate 1500 flying hours to get their Airport Transport Pilot License (ATPL). At this point, the student may work for an airline and he or she will have a valid FAA Pilot License which is the most prestigious in the world.
1551.title: B.Tech Aerospace Engineering with Pathway to Pilot Program

The student also will get placement assistance and the student can start working for prestigious airlines such as Cathay Pacific, Emirates, Etihad, Turkish Airlines, and many others while he or she can also apply to become a charter pilot (Bahamas region) or even a cargo pilot along with any other opportunities. This assistance is given to the student and if the student wishes to fly in the USA, he or she gets an additional 12 months of OPT which allows the student to stay back and work in the USA as a pilot for 2 years including the study internship. In case of a full-time job offer, then the student can be eligible for an employment visa and eventually a green card as well.
### Pilot License for India
The student can also return to India and convert his or her license to an Indian Pilot License through the DGCA process.

1724.content:
#### Duration2 Years
#### Course Fee2.30 Lakhs
#### EligibilityBachelor's degree in relevant discipline.
#### The MA in Political Science (International Relations) is a two-year postgraduate programme designed to provide an advanced understanding of global politics, foreign policy, and the strategic interactions between states and international actors.
The programme equips students with theoretical and analytical tools to interpret contemporary world affairs, global challenges related to governance, diplomatic practices, and issues of international security. Through a combination of core political science foundations and specialised IR courses, students gain the ability to assess international events critically, analyse foreign policy behaviour, and engage in informed research on global issues. Graduates are prepared for careers in diplomacy, international organisations, research institutions, global NGOs, strategic analysis, media, and academia.
1724.title: M.A. (Political Science)

1725.content:
#### Program Specialisation
The MA in Political Science ( Specialisation in Public Policy) is a two-year postgraduate programme designed to develop a deep understanding of how public decisions are made, implemented, and evaluated. the programme is tailored by combining political science theory with practical policy analysis. It provides students with exposure to governance processes, development strategies, public management, and evidence-based policymaking.
Students are trained to assess public problems, design policy solutions, advocacy and evaluate their outcomes using qualitative and quantitative tools. Graduates of the program are prepared for positions where knowledgeable policy expertise is crucial, such as government agencies, policy think tanks, development organisations, non-governmental organisations, consulting firms, and academic research institutions.

# Bachelor of Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology (BMRIT)

#### Duration3 year + 1 year Compulsory Internship
#### Course Fee6.30 Lakhs
#### Eligibility10+2
#### Medical imaging is an integral part of modern healthcare, enabling accurate diagnosis and effective treatment planning across a wide range of medical conditions.
Skilled radiology professionals play a vital role in delivering high-quality diagnostic imaging services that support clinical decision-making and patient care.
The Bachelor of Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology (BMRIT) at GD Goenka University is a four-year full-time undergraduate programme designed to prepare students for a dynamic and technology-driven medical imaging environment, followed by extensive clinical training and internship exposure.
1807.title: Bachelor of Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology (BMRIT)

1808.content:
#### Program Specialisation
The programme is structured to provide a strong foundation in human anatomy, physiology, pathology, radiation physics, and imaging sciences, while offering comprehensive training in conventional radiography, computed tomography (CT), magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), ultrasound, fluoroscopy, mammography, and other advanced diagnostic imaging modalities.
With a strong emphasis on experiential learning, students gain hands-on clinical experience in hospitals and diagnostic imaging centres, working alongside radiologists, clinicians, and allied healthcare professionals. The curriculum seamlessly integrates theoretical knowledge with practical training, enabling students to develop technical expertise, clinical competence, and patient-centred care skills.
1808.title: Bachelor of Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology (BMRIT)

1809.content:
#### Program Specialisation

The programme also emphasizes radiation safety, quality assurance, healthcare management, medical ethics, communication skills, and research methodology, ensuring graduates are well-equipped to meet professional standards and adapt to emerging advancements in medical imaging technology.
Graduates are well-prepared for rewarding careers in hospitals, diagnostic imaging centres, specialty clinics, research institutions, and healthcare organizations as Radiology Technologists, CT Technologists, MRI Technologists, Ultrasound Assistants, Cath Lab Technologists, Imaging Specialists, and other allied healthcare professionals, contributing significantly to accurate diagnosis, patient management, and improved healthcare outcomes.

#### Admission Process – Bachelor of Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology (BMRIT)
The following are the eligibility criteria for admission to the Bachelor of Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology (BMRIT) programme:
 * Candidates must have passed the 10+2 examination or its equivalent from a recognized State/Central Board with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English as compulsory subjects.
 * Applicants must have completed 17 years of age on or before 31st December of the year of admission.
 * Candidates with equivalent qualifications recognized by GD Goenka University are also eligible to apply.
 * Admission is based on the prescribed eligibility criteria and successful qualification in the Goenka Aptitude Test for Admission (GATA) followed by a Personal Interview (PI), as per the University's admission policy.
1822.title: Bachelor of Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology (BMRIT)

#### Admission Process – Bachelor of Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology (BMRIT)

**Lateral Entry Admission**
 * Candidates holding a minimum two-year Diploma in Medical Imaging Technology/Radiography or an equivalent qualification from a recognized Government Body are eligible for direct admission to the 3rd semester (Second Year), subject to meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria and University/NCAHP norms.

1831.title: Bachelors in Medical Laboratory Sciences (BMLS)

1832.content:
#### Bachelors in Medical Laboratory Sciences (BMLS) is an undergraduate 4-year program designed to impart knowledge and skills needed to become a qualified medical laboratory technologist.

This branch of science which deals with all the clinical laboratory investigations on clinical samples for laboratory diagnosis of various diseases. Blood, tissue and body fluids are analyzed and examined for various types of foreign organisms and abnormalities. This information is then used by the medical team to make decisions regarding a patient's medical care. 85% of all medical decisions are based on the results of clinical laboratory investigation reports. It is the Medical Laboratory Technocrat, who performs this important task by various scientific tools and techniques. In today ‘s modern world of technology, the diagnosis, treatment & prognosis of various diseases depends upon the results of investigations carried out in a clinical laboratory. Thus, these professionals play a key role in the field of health care. As modern medicine becomes more of a team effort, the Medical Laboratory Scientist/Technologist is an important member and integral part of the Medical team.

# B.Sc. Cardiovascular Technology (CVT)

#### Duration3 Years + 1 Year Compulsory Internship
#### Course Fee6.30 Lakhs
#### Eligibility10+2
#### Cardiovascular health is at the core of modern healthcare, and skilled professionals in this field play a critical role in diagnosing and managing heart-related conditions.
The **Bachelor of Science in Cardiovascular Technology (CVT)** at GD Goenka University is a four-year full-time undergraduate programme designed to prepare students for a dynamic and rapidly evolving cardiac care environment, followed by extensive clinical training and internship exposure.
The programme is structured to build a strong foundation in human anatomy, physiology, pathology, pharmacology, and medical technology, while also providing advanced training in cardiovascular diagnostics such as ECG, echocardiography, treadmill testing, ambulatory ECG monitoring and cardiac catheterization lab procedures.
1851.title: B.Sc. Cardiovascular Technology (CVT)

1852.content:
#### Program Specialisation
With a strong emphasis on hands-on clinical learning, students gain real-time experience in hospitals and cardiac care units, working alongside cardiologists and healthcare professionals. The curriculum is designed to integrate theory with practice, ensuring students develop both technical competence and clinical confidence.
The programme also focuses on communication skills, medical ethics, research methodology, and healthcare management, enabling students to grow into responsible and industry-ready professionals.
Graduates are well-prepared for careers in hospitals, diagnostic centres, and cardiac care units as cardiovascular technologists, echocardiography technicians, cath lab technologists, and allied healthcare specialists, contributing meaningfully to patient care and cardiac health services.

1866.content:
#### Career Path
The B.Sc. Cardiovascular Technology programme provides a wide range of career opportunities in the areas of clinical practice, diagnostic cardiology, healthcare technology, research and healthcare administration across both national and international healthcare systems. Graduates play a vital role in supporting advanced cardiac care services and diagnostic laboratories.
 * **Multispecialty Hospitals:** Assist cardiologists in ECG, ECHO, stress tests, and cath lab procedures for diagnosis and patient care.
 * **Cardiac Super-Specialty Centres:** Support advanced cardiac diagnostics, interventional procedures, and critical care monitoring.
 * **Diagnostic Laboratories:** Perform non-invasive tests like ECG, Holter monitoring, and echocardiography for disease detection and follow-up.
 * **Research & Clinical Trials:** Contribute to cardiovascular research, device testing, and advancement of cardiac technologies.
1866.title: B.Sc. Cardiovascular Technology (CVT)

1867.content:
#### Career Path

* **Research & Clinical Trials:** Contribute to cardiovascular research, device testing, and advancement of cardiac technologies.
 * **Medical Equipment Industry:** Work in technical support, installation, training, and application of cardiac diagnostic equipment.
 * **Academics:** Become lecturers or instructors after higher studies (M.Sc., MBA, Ph.D.).
 * **Entrepreneurship & Consultancy: ** Set up diagnostic centres or provide independent cardiac diagnostic services.
 * **International Opportunities:** Work in global hospitals with additional certifications and experience.
1867.title: B.Sc. Cardiovascular Technology (CVT)

1869.content:
#### Admission Process
 * Candidates must have passed the 10+2 examination conducted by a recognized State or Central Board, or an examination recognized as equivalent by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU). The candidate must have studied English as one of the subjects along with Physics and Chemistry, and Biology (P.C.B.) as a mandatory subject combination.
 * Candidates with any other qualification approved by GD Goenka University as equivalent to the above are also eligible to apply.
 * In addition, applicants are required to successfully qualify the Goenka Aptitude Test for Admission (GATA) followed by a personal interview as part of the selection process.

#### Lateral Entry Admission
Candidates possessing a minimum two-year Diploma in Cardiovascular Technology or a relevant allied health discipline from a recognized institute are eligible for lateral entry admission into the programme as per university norms.
1869.title: B.Sc. Cardiovascular Technology (CVT)

1870.content:
#### Frequently Asked Questions
Which program is offered?
B.Sc. in Cardiovascular Technology, a 4-year program with a 1-year clinical internship.
What is the eligibility?
10+2 with **PCB (Physics, Chemistry, Biology)** and minimum 50% marks.
How to apply?
Apply online through the official GD Goenka University website by filling the form and submitting documents.
Is there an entrance exam?
Admission is mainly merit-based; however, **GATA or interview** may be conducted if required.
What are the career options?
Cardiovascular Technologist, Cath Lab Technician, ECG/Echo Technician, and roles in hospitals and diagnostic centres.
Is internship included?
Yes, a compulsory **1-year clinical internship** in hospitals is part of the program.
What facilities are available?
Advanced labs for ECG, ECHO, simulation training, smart classrooms, and hospital tie-ups.
Can international students apply?
Yes, subject to eligibility, equivalence of qualification, and visa requirements.

Any aggrieved student can submit his/her grievance in writing to the office of the Dean of his/her respective school which will be taken up by the School Grievance Redressal Committee within five working days.

Level II

An appeal may be submitted to the office of the Dean-Student Welfare, GDGU along with the copy of the decision of SGRC for review/reconsideration within seven working days from the date of the decision at Level I.

# Internal Committee
Internal Committee at GD Goenka University functions as per the provisions contained in the Regulations on Prevention of Sexual Harassment and Vishaka Guidelines against Sexual Harassment at Workplace and UGC Gazette Notification on Prevention, prohibition and redressal of sexual harassment of women employees and students in higher educational institutions Regulations 2015.
1919.title: Internal Committee

1920.content:
## Punishments, if found Guilty of Sexual Harassment
Under the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act, 2013 & UGC (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal of Sexual Harassment of Women Employees and Students in Higher Educational Institutions) Regulations, 2015, anyone can file a Complaint, if one is being sexually harassed.
**Anyone found Guilty of sexual harassment shall be punished in accordance with the service rules (teaching/non-teaching) of the University.**
**Where the respondent is a student, depending upon the severity of the offence, the university may.**
 * Withold privileges of the student such as access to the library, Auditoria, Halls of residence, Transportation, Scholarships, allowances and identity card.
 * Suspend or restrict entry into the campus for the specific period.
 * Expel and strike off name from the rolls of the institution, including denial of readmission, if the offence so warrants.
1920.title: Internal Committee

1922.content:
## Action against Frivolous Complaint
**Complaint Mechanism**
 * The complaint mechanism is secure, easy to access, and sensitive.
 * Complaints can be submitted in writing or via email on ic@gdgu.org to any committee member within three months of the incident.
 * The receiving member must inform the Chairperson within two working days.
 * Meetings require at least five days' notice, except in emergencies.
 * Within 10 days, the committee will decide if an inquiry is needed.
 * If no inquiry is conducted, reasons must be recorded and shared with the complainant.
 * No complainant, witness, or defendant can be a committee member during the inquiry.
 * Filing a complaint will not negatively impact the complainant’s job, grades, or status.
1922.title: Internal Committee

1923.content:
## Enquiry by the Committee Against Sexual Harassment
Some of the functions expected of the IQAC
 * The committee will follow natural justice and gender sensitivity, completing the inquiry within 90 days.
 * Separate hearings will be held to ensure a safe environment, and all identities will be protected.
 * The complainant may have one representative, and both parties can present witnesses and evidence.
 * If the defendant misses three hearings without reason, the committee may decide the case ex parte.
 * All proceedings will be documented, and complainants may go public but are advised to wait until the inquiry is complete.
 * Only written questions via the committee will be allowed, ensuring no direct confrontation.
 * The committee can summon official papers, and parties must ensure their witnesses appear.
 * Participants must maintain confidentiality, and case details will not be disclosed under the Right to Information Act.
1923.title: Internal Committee

1924.content:
## Enquiry by the Committee Against Sexual Harassment

* Participants must maintain confidentiality, and case details will not be disclosed under the Right to Information Act.
 * The committee recognizes that direct evidence may not always be available and will handle cases accordingly.
 * A detailed report of findings, evidence, and conclusions will be prepared after the inquiry.
 * After the inquiry, the committee will dismiss baseless complaints or, if proven, recommend disciplinary action based on the severity of the offense.
1924.title: Internal Committee

1927.title: Home

1928.content:
# Home
GD Goenka University Aerospace Engineering Department has been formed due to increasing demand for Aerospace professionals across the world and across India. Especially with the potential of India to become one of the Aerospace Hubs in the world with its competence in space exploration through ISRO and also being one of the biggest aviation markets in the world, Aerospace Engineering Professionals are in more demand than ever.
Enquire Now!
GD Goenka as an education hub with its 150+ K12 schools and [GD Goenka University]() offers _B.Tech Aerospace Engineering Degree with specialisation in Aeronautics, Astronautics, Avionics and Defence Technologies._ You can also learn how to design airplanes, helicopters, satellites, rockets, radars, communication systems or defense systems after studying Aerospace Engineering in India at GD Goenka Aerospace Engineering Department.
1928.title: Home

1929.content:
# Home

In addition, we have a _Pathway to Pilot Program where you can earn your Aerospace Engineering Degree in India and Commercial Pilot License in USA within 4 years_. You study 3 years in GD Goenka and study the 4th year in a flight school in USA. This way you get both your Aerospace Engineering degree and CPL at the same time. You can also study 3 years and get your DGCA CPL license by jointly studying for your degree and flying a plane every semester with our BSc Aviation with CPL Pilot License Program.
1929.title: Home

1930.content:
# Home

Furthermore, at Master’s level, _GD Goenka Aerospace Engineering Department offers MTech Aerospace Degree and you can choose from 3 specialisations of Aeronautics & UAV, Space Technology and CFD. _ Especially MTech CFD is very popular with the industry and there is a great demand and you can learn from the best Aerospace and CFD professionals at GD Goenka Aerospace Department. Second year of the Mtech Program is designed as a pure internship in India and abroad. Our students are trained to be able to work anywhere in the World.
Our PhD Program in Aerospace Engineering is designed to train the future academicians and senior industry consultants in the future. You can join to do your PhD partly in India and partly abroad under the supervision of Aerospace Faculty.
1930.title: Home

1931.content:
# Home

Hence, if you wish to study Aerospace Engineering in India, then [GD Goenka Aerospace Engineering program]() is one of the best with its national and international industrial partners, internship and study abroad opportunities, immersion programs to space organisations, airports and space launch facilities along with its advanced cutting edge research opportunities. Our department is the only Aerospace Department in India that sends you to mandatory student exchange or Aerospace internship abroad and mentors you with international faculty and international aerospace industry professionals.
Please click the [Programs]() tab to see our BTech, Masters and PhD Programs in Aerospace Engineering. Study Aerospace Engineering in India and get an Aerospace Engineer degree with full hands on experience, international internships, and with employment opportunities both in India and abroad.

Ph.D.s are awarded for programs across the whole breadth of academic fields. Because it is an earned research degree, those studying for a Ph.D. are required to produce original research that expands the boundaries of knowledge, normally in the form of a thesis or dissertation, and defend their work against experts in the field. The completion of a Ph.D. is often a requirement for employment as a university professor, researcher, or scientist in many fields. 1951.content:
#### Frequently Asked Questions
What are the PhD programmes that GD Goenka University provides?
Widely acclaimed as one of the top academic institutions, GD Goenka University offers doctoral programmes across multiple fields. From Engineering, Agriculture, and Humanities & Social Science to Law, Management, and Medical and Allied Sciences, the choices are extensive. Whatever your area of interest, you can opt for a full-time or part-time PhD programme at GD Goenka University based on your preference and suitability.
What are the preconditions a student must satisfy to apply for admission?
GD Goenka University is a premier destination for PhD studies in Delhi NCR. Several senior professionals from the education fraternity, as well as many meritorious national and international students, join our doctoral programme every year. Here are the prerequisites for enrolling in our PhD programme:
 * You must have completed your Master's degree from a UGC or AIU-recognised university.
1951.title: Ph.D programmes

1952.content:
#### Frequently Asked Questions

* You must have completed your Master's degree from a UGC or AIU-recognised university.
 * A minimum of 55% marks in aggregate is mandatory.
 * Foreign students, NRI applicants, or candidates with a Master's degree from an overseas university must provide an equivalency certificate at the time of PhD application.
1952.title: Ph.D programmes

1953.content:
#### Frequently Asked Questions

Can you explain the admission process step-by-step?
To enrol at the GD Goenka University Ph.D. programme, follow the given guidelines:
 * First, you must fill out the online application form.
 * Second, sit for the entrance examination and interview.
 * Third, once qualified, you will receive the admission offer. Complete your coursework thereafter.
 * Fourth, the college will provide the best guide and mentor to help you with thesis writing.
 * Fifth, complete your thesis and submit it.

Research is an integral part of Doctoral studies. How does GD Goenka University assist the candidates in that aspect?
Whether you opt for a full-time or part-time Ph.D. admission, GD Goenka University will ensure you get the best research facilities for your doctoral studies. That is why the institute takes great strides to team up with top private and government sector industries, various NGOs, community organisations and other research institutions.

# Overview
Agriculture education at GD Goenka University is different. As one of the most prestigious colleges in Gurgaon, We provide exceptional employment prospects as a result of our commitment to academic excellence, focus on teaching, research, and holistic education, and the benefits of our being in the National Capital Region (NCR) location. Guided by the recommendations of the Vth Deans Committee of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR), we have meticulously crafted a curriculum comprising each aspect of Agriculture.
1977.title: Overview

1978.content:
# Overview

It is with great pride that we proclaim our accreditation by ICAR, which is a mark of quality and excellence in the field of agricultural education. As one of the best colleges for B.Sc (Hons.) agriculture, we have the proficient teaching professionals working with us. Our faculty and students are actively involved in research. We understand that the pillars of an educational institution are its faculty members and we have some of the best brains from Industry and prominent Institutions.
1978.title: Overview

1979.content:
#### Our Mission
The mission of School of Agricultural Sciences is
 * To establish a strong foundation in the fundamentals linking knowledge and skills through experiential learning
 * To develop a system of excellence in pedagogy for teaching and research to bring improvements in the agricultural sector
 * To foster hands-on, immersive, evidence-based research and fieldwork training opportunities to students in order to create innovative solutions for sustainable agricultural practices
 * To empower its diverse faculty and staff to innovate, discover, and push the frontiers of knowledge to address critical education and research needs of modern society
 * To strive for community engagement by supporting local agriculture as envisioned in the NEP 2020
1979.title: Overview

To be a globally recognised agricultural sciences school that enables learners to gain knowledge and skill through research and innovation, interdisciplinary education, producing socially responsible, self-motivated future leaders, driving sustainable growth.

As an agriculture college in Delhi NCR, the campus has state-of-the-art infrastructure which is fully air-conditioned along with Wi-Fi connectivity, well-equipped laboratories, libraries, cafeteria, and hostel, and also offers opportunities to participate in a variety of extra-curricular activities and sports. As one of the best colleges for B.Sc (Hons.) agriculture, the university has the best teaching faculties that explain difficult topics to the students using various engaging teaching methods. Building upon the group’s strong history, GD Goenka University, one of the best colleges for B.Sc (Hons.) agriculture offers education that is in line with international standards. 1985.title: Agriculture education at GD Goenka University is moving ahead for modernization with AI.

1986.content:
### School of Agricultural Sciences, GD Goenka University
It is my privilege to welcome you to the School of Agricultural Sciences at GD Goenka University. Agriculture, the backbone of our nation, is rapidly transforming with the integration of science, technology, and sustainability. Our School is dedicated to preparing young minds who will lead this transformation, ensuring food security, climate resilience, and innovative agri-business solutions for the future.
To ensure holistic development, we provide our students with world-class infrastructure and hands-on learning opportunities.
The School is enriched with a state-of-the-art Hydroponics Facility, Mushroom Production Unit, Organic Farm, and Beekeeping Unit, where students gain practical exposure to modern and sustainable farming systems. Our Incubation Center for Entrepreneurship Promotion and Skill Enhancement Courses focus on empowering young minds with the knowledge, skills, and confidence to launch their own agri-startups.
1986.title: Agriculture education at GD Goenka University is moving ahead for modernization with AI.

1987.content:
### School of Agricultural Sciences, GD Goenka University

We also house advanced ICAR-standard laboratories, including a Central Research Laboratory with cutting-edge instruments and specialized labs for Crop Improvement, Crop Protection, Agronomy, Social Sciences, and Horticulture, ensuring robust training for both UG and PG students. Furthermore, the Center for Application of Artificial Intelligence in Agriculture provides students with opportunities to explore precision farming, smart data-driven solutions, and frontier technologies that will define the future of agriculture.
1987.title: Agriculture education at GD Goenka University is moving ahead for modernization with AI.

1988.content:
### School of Agricultural Sciences, GD Goenka University

School of Agricultural Sciences houses advanced laboratories designed as per ICAR norms, including a Central Research Laboratory with cutting-edge instruments, along with specialized labs for Crop Improvement, Crop Protection, Agronomy, Social Sciences, and Horticulture- offering UG and PG students a strong foundation in both research and applied sciences. In addition, we provide an unparalleled ecosystem for experiential learning. Our state-of-the-art Hydroponics Facility, Mushroom Production Unit, Organic Farm, and Beekeeping Unit expose students to practical farming systems and modern agribusiness opportunities. To nurture innovation and self-reliance, our Incubation Center for Entrepreneurship Promotion encourages students to translate ideas into successful ventures
1988.title: Agriculture education at GD Goenka University is moving ahead for modernization with AI.

1990.content:
### School of Agricultural Sciences, GD Goenka University

With 43 years of experience in agricultural education and research, over 200 scientific publications, leadership in successful crop variety development, and recognition with 12 awards including a Lifetime Achievement Award, I have witnessed the power of knowledge, technology, and youth in transforming agriculture. At GD Goenka University, our mission is to nurture competent professionals, visionary researchers, and dynamic entrepreneurs who will redefine agriculture at both national and global levels. I warmly invite you to join us in this journey of growth, innovation and service to society/the Nation.
Prof. (Dr.) Shiv Singh Tomar
Dean, School of Agricultural Sciences,GD Goenka University

2023.content:
# Career

After pursuing courses in agriculture field, the students can apply for jobs in government as well as in private organizations. There are various job opportunities are available for agriculture graduate aspirants. Agriculture field offers job opportunities in horticulture, poultry farming, plant science, soil science, food science, animal science, etc. They can find research-oriented jobs or marketing jobs in these organizations. They can be appointed in National Agricultural Research System (NARS) including ICAR and different laboratories under Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) which focus on agricultural research. They can also teach in different colleges or universities after qualifying the NET exam. They can also get into the agricultural department of the government after qualifying the concerned exam. Several agricultural research institutes under government are also recruiting these graduates for the post of agricultural scientist
2023.title: Career

2024.content:
# Career

. Several agricultural research institutes under government are also recruiting these graduates for the post of agricultural scientist. These graduates can work as plant protection specialists in various plant quarantine stations. Some of the other agricultural activities that give attractive returns are horticulture, dairying & poultry farming. As a landscapers and horticultures one can get employed in hotels, health farms, resorts, etc.
2024.title: Career

2025.content:
# Career

Self employment opportunities are also available in this field. After completing graduation in this field and with some experience, they can apply for various posts available in National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD). They can also be employed as agricultural managers/inspectors in farm-related organizations, agro-industries, food-processing unit, dairy fields, NGO's and breeding centers. They can also set up their own business in the primary economic sector such as farming, plantations, fisheries, mining, cattle rearing, poultry farming, etc.
After completing postgraduate degree in agriculture, candidates can work as a supervisors, distributors, researcher & engineer.
2025.title: Career

2026.content:
### Career Pathway
##### Employment Sectors
A degree from agriculture enables the students to pursue a meaningful career or continue their education in professional school. The degree gives the students the knowledge and skills to either manage agricultural teaching, research or businesses or work in the areas of agricultural sales, marketing, food production and agricultural journalism. Opportunity awaits the students in one of the many career paths below.
 * Central and State Government Ministries and Departments
 * Indian Council of Agricultural Research
 * Agricultural universities and various agricultural service organizations
 * National Seeds Corporation Limited
 * State Farms Corporation of India
 * Krishi Vigyan Kendras
 * Agriculture/Dairy/Fertilizer industries
 * Academic Institutions
 * Food Processing Units/Agricultural Products Marketing firms
 * Nationalized Banks and Rural Banks
 * Private jobs ( NGOs) , marketing and sales executives in different agro-based industries
2026.title: Career

2027.content:
### Career Pathway

* Food Processing Units/Agricultural Products Marketing firms
 * Nationalized Banks and Rural Banks
 * Private jobs ( NGOs) , marketing and sales executives in different agro-based industries
 * Farm Input delivery centres such as Agri Clinics, Seed/pesticides/fertilizer dealerships/shops.
2027.title: Career

2028.content:
### Career Pathway

##### Research and Extension activities
Agriculture being the backbone of Indian economy, agricultural scientists are necessary to help solve problems involving food quality, safety, technology and abundance. The students can find following careers in research, teaching and extension following careers
State Agricultural Universities/ICAR Institutes
 * **Research** - Agronomist/ Food Scientist/Entomologist/Plant Pathologist/Plant Breeder/Biotechnologist, Agricultural Research Scientist/Research Associates/Young professionals
 * **Teaching** - Assistant Professor, Assistant Scientist
 * **Agricultural** **Extension-** Extension specialist, Subject Matter experts, Food Scientist
 * **Engineering** - Irrigation Engineer/Watershed Scientist/ Assistant Engineer
 * Horticulture Officer, Agricultural Development Officer, Soil Conservation Officer, Rural Agriculture Extension Officer,
2028.title: Career

2029.content:
### Career Pathway

##### Agribusiness/Food production
Job opportunities in fresh, locally grown food production, poultry and swine production, crop production, forest management, and precision agriculture are growing. These agribusinesses need researchers, inspectors, quality assurance and more. Other business opportunities in agriculture include sales, marketing, commodities trading, farm management and policy analysis.The students get following opportunities
 * Seed production manager
 * Poultry Production Manager
 * Precision Agricultural Specialist
 * Fruit and Vegetable Grower
 * Forest Manager/Crop management consultant
 * Organic Crops Grower
 * Aquaculturist
2029.title: Career

2030.content:
### Career Pathway

##### Banking Sector
Banks and credit agencies that lend to agribusinesses hire loan officers, credit analysts and appraisers, and agriculture-oriented companies need accountants. They work in the domain of agriculture related financing business like Crop loans, tractor loans, financing of priority sector categories under NABARD schemes.Banks in India recruit BSc Graduates under Specialist Officers Cadre. Other opportunities are:
 * Agriculture Field Officer
 * Assistant Manager
 * Probationary Officer
 * Agriculture Officer
 * Relationship manager
 * Agriculture Loan Officer (in Banks)
2030.title: Career

2031.content:
### Career Pathway

##### Horticulture
Commercial and residential landscaping firms, as well as nurseries, require agriculture professionals for a wide range of roles. These include plant production, therapy-based gardening, garden design, arboriculture, management, and sales.
Career opportunities in this field span across wholesale growers, botanical gardens, arboretums, universities, and landscaping organizations.
A minor in business can be especially beneficial for students interested in managing nurseries or landscaping operations. Additionally, strong communication skills — including speaking, writing, and photography — are valuable for roles that involve public interaction.
**Career opportunities in this sector include:**
 * Technical Assistant / Technical Officer
 * Horticulturist
 * Assistant Manager
 * Farm Manager
 * Project Manager
 * Horticultural Education Supervisor
 * Landscape Manager
2031.title: Career

2032.content:
### Career Pathway

##### Agricultural Journalism
Communication jobs are essential to provide critical information to producers and consumers of the industry. Government agricultural agencies maintain the industry policies and legislation to ensure they remain effective and up to date.
 * Technical Writer
 * Agricultural Media Specialist
 * Food and Agricultural Science Editor
 * Agricultural Event and Meeting Planner
 * Magazine journalist
 * Newspaper journalist
2032.title: Career

2033.content:
### Career Pathway

##### Marketing pathways
For the marketing of products and services to consumers and clients through the development of campaigns, and coordination throughout the different business functions is necessary for improving marketing functions of a commodity. Conducting research to determine new markets and how well products are satisfying current markets, seeking customers for produce in new areas, maintaining relationships with current customers, meeting with farmers, consumers, agribusiness leaders, and media members are all required in this filed. The students can seek following roles:
 * Agriculture Sales officers
 * Sales Managers
 * Agriculture Area Managers and Marketing officers
 * Senior Sales Executive
 * Development Officer
 * Sales Trainee
2033.title: Career

2034.content:
### Career Pathway

##### Higher Studies
Students with an undergraduate degree in agriculture also have the educational foundation for an advanced degree in business management or specialization in agriculture related fields through various scholarship schemes:
 * ICAR’s common entrance tests for 25 percent seats in CAUs and 15 percent seats in SAUs including meritorious students for Senior Research Fellowships
 * BHU Entrance examination
 * AMU Entrance examination for agriculture faculties & ABM
 * Visva Bharti University (CU)-25 percent seats
 * JNU Entrance test for MSc Agri Biotechnology and MVSc-12 Universities
 * SAUs Entrance examination (85 percent of the seats)
 * MS in foreign Universities
 * Traditional Universities having agri faculties & Private Universities

2038.content:
### Workshop on Basic Molecular Techniques

**Organized by** - GD Goenka University, Haryana **Date** - 2 Feb 2026
The Department of Basic and Applied Sciences, School of Engineering and Sciences (SoES), in collaboration with the School of Agricultural Sciences (SoAS), successfully organized a one-day workshop titled “Basic Molecular Techniques” on 02 February 2026 at GD Goenka University. The workshop was conducted at the B-Block Auditorium and Laboratory B217 and aimed at enhancing students’ theoretical understanding and practical exposure to fundamental molecular biology techniques.
2038.title: Workshop On Basic Molecular Techniques

2039.content:
### Workshop on Basic Molecular Techniques

The workshop commenced with an inaugural session, wherein the importance of molecular techniques in modern biological research, diagnostics, and industry was emphasized. The event featured expert sessions by Dr. Archana Dayal, Director, Zenomix BioLab Pvt. Ltd., who delivered an insightful offline lecture focusing on industry expectations, career opportunities in biological sciences, and the application of molecular tools in research and biotechnology industries. Her session effectively bridged the gap between academic learning and industry requirements.
2039.title: Workshop On Basic Molecular Techniques

2040.content:
### Workshop on Basic Molecular Techniques

The second session was delivered online by Dr. Pushpender Kumar Sharma, Amity University, Jaipur, who elaborated on the principles and applications of basic and advanced molecular techniques. He provided detailed explanations on DNA extraction, quantification methods, and polymerase chain reaction (PCR), highlighting their significance in research and diagnostics. The third expert session, conducted online by Dr. Sonia Kumari Shishodia, UIBT, Chandigarh University, focused on gel electrophoresis, DNA visualization, DNA ligation, and bacterial transformation, offering valuable insights into experimental design and laboratory best practices.
A dedicated hands-on session was organized in Laboratory B217, where participants gained practical exposure to selected molecular techniques. This session significantly enhanced the participants’ conceptual clarity, laboratory skills, and confidence in handling molecular biology experiments.

2042.title: Expert Insights Use Of Artificial Intelligence Of Plant Breeding By Dr Ujjawal Kumar Singh Kushwaha Scientist Nepal Agricultural Research Council

2043.content:
### Expert Insights “Use of Artificial Intelligence of Plant Breeding” by Dr. Ujjawal Kumar Singh Kushwaha, Scientist (Nepal Agricultural Research Council)

The expert lecture titled “Use of Artificial Intelligence in Plant Breeding” was organized with the objective of introducing researchers, faculty members, and students to the emerging role of artificial intelligence (AI) in transforming modern plant breeding practices. The event aimed to bridge the gap between conventional breeding approaches and advanced computational technologies that are increasingly shaping agricultural research and crop improvement programs worldwide.
2043.title: Expert Insights Use Of Artificial Intelligence Of Plant Breeding By Dr Ujjawal Kumar Singh Kushwaha Scientist Nepal Agricultural Research Council

2044.content:
### Expert Insights “Use of Artificial Intelligence of Plant Breeding” by Dr. Ujjawal Kumar Singh Kushwaha, Scientist (Nepal Agricultural Research Council)

The session began with an overview of the challenges faced by traditional plant breeding, including long breeding cycles, complex genotype–environment interactions, limitations in phenotyping accuracy, and the increasing demand for climate-resilient and high-yielding crop varieties. The speaker emphasized that while conventional breeding methods have significantly contributed to agricultural productivity, the growing global population, climate change, and shrinking agricultural resources necessitate faster and more precise breeding strategies. In this context, artificial intelligence has emerged as a powerful tool capable of accelerating decision-making and improving selection efficiency.
2044.title: Expert Insights Use Of Artificial Intelligence Of Plant Breeding By Dr Ujjawal Kumar Singh Kushwaha Scientist Nepal Agricultural Research Council

2045.content:
### Expert Insights “Use of Artificial Intelligence of Plant Breeding” by Dr. Ujjawal Kumar Singh Kushwaha, Scientist (Nepal Agricultural Research Council)

The expert elaborated on the fundamental concepts of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and deep learning, explaining their relevance to agricultural data analysis. Particular attention was given to the integration of AI with genomics, phenomics, and environmental datasets. The use of AI algorithms in predicting genotype performance, identifying desirable traits, and optimizing parental selection was discussed in detail. Examples were presented demonstrating how machine learning models can analyze large datasets to identify patterns that may not be easily detectable through conventional statistical approaches.
2045.title: Expert Insights Use Of Artificial Intelligence Of Plant Breeding By Dr Ujjawal Kumar Singh Kushwaha Scientist Nepal Agricultural Research Council

### Workshop on Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR)

On 29 January 2026, the Department of Basic and Applied Sciences, School of Engineering & Sciences (SoES), GD Goenka University organized a workshop on Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR). The sessions were led by Mr. Anuraag Singh, CEO & Co-Founder, Systools, and Mr. Viral Patel, GM – DFIR Operations, Systools, who delivered in-depth, industry-focused insights into DFIR fundamentals, real-world investigation lifecycles, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), career pathways in digital forensics and cyber investigations, along with live demonstrations of widely used DFIR tools.
2218.title: Workshop On Digital Forensics  Incident Response Dfir

2219.content:
### Workshop on Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR)

The workshop was organized for students and faculty members from the Forensic Science and Cybersecurity programs. It commenced with a welcome address by Prof. (Dr.) K. Thammi Reddy, Dean, School of Engineering and Sciences, who highlighted the importance of Digital Forensics as a critical need of the hour. He warmly welcomed Systools for collaboration and emphasized the significance of professional certifications in the field of Digital Forensics.
Mr. Anuraag Singh initiated the session with an overview of DFIR fundamentals, detailing the processes involved in identifying cyber incidents, carrying out investigations, and ensuring secure information management. Mr. Viral Patel further discussed various cybercrimes and data breaches, highlighting effective organizational response strategies to protect digital systems and reduce potential impact. A major emphasis was placed on maintaining the integrity of digital evidence through appropriate handling and preservation protocols.

The visit offered students a valuable opportunity to witness cutting-edge AI innovations across healthcare, agriculture, education, smart cities, robotics, and sustainable development. They explored live demonstrations of AI-powered healthcare diagnostics, smart surveillance systems, autonomous robotics, intelligent automation platforms, and AI-enabled data solutions addressing real-world societal challenges.
2244.title: Visit Of Students To The India Ai Impact Summit 2026

This enriching exposure helped students connect classroom learning with emerging industry trends, inspiring them to innovate and contribute to the future of AI-driven technology.
2245.title: Visit Of Students To The India Ai Impact Summit 2026

# Overview
The School of Liberal Arts (SoLA) at G.D. Goenka University is designed to provide an interdisciplinary, holistic, and student-centric education that goes beyond traditional disciplinary boundaries. It encourages students to explore, question, and engage critically with ideas, fostering creativity, intellectual curiosity, and a deeper understanding of the world.

2256.content:
#### Choose the Best Arts College in Delhi NCR
Whether you’re looking for the top BA Colleges in Delhi or are on your way to take admission to the best Political Science College in Delhi, there is something to be said for Arts courses. From Languages to Sociology, Psychology to Economics, English Literature, Travel and tourism, and Political Science, among others; a good College of Arts can offer you many vistas. These days, degrees in Art courses are in high demand as it works as the stepping stone for a graduate to build their career in an industry of their choice. You can easily find work in many fields, including advertising, marketing, designing, fashion, photography, education, and many more.

When you pursue courses in art, you are able to gain a better understanding of human nature, culture, and creative expression. The various courses that are offered under the School of Liberal Arts offer students a lucrative career path and a flexibility to transition to professionally fulfilling and financially rewarding roles.
2257.title: Overview

#### GD Goenka University: Counted among the Best MA Colleges in Delhi NCR
While there’s no harm in keeping a tab and being inclined towards the best Psychology or Economics College in Delhi NCR, look for one that offers you all round development and growth. School of Liberal Arts at GD Goenka offers several undergraduate courses in fields like English, Sociology, Political Science, Economics, Psychology, Travel & Tourism among others, as well as a Post Graduate Programme in Psychology. The Faculty at GD Goenka University is well-known for helping students develop and apply novel theoretical perspectives to even the most pressing issues of today. As one of the top Universities in Arts, GD Goenka provides students with liberal education, helping them imbibe a refinement in reasoning, excellence in communication, openness to new ideas, as well as a commitment to democratic values and ethical behaviour.

2259.content:
#### Our Mission
 * To establish a strong foundation in the fundamentals of liberal education, linking knowledge and skills through experiential learning
 * To create competent and ethical professionals committed to the practice and application of their discipline to the outside world
 * To promote inter-disciplinary and collaborative learning and promote a diversity of ideas in teaching, research and innovation
 * To contribute to the development of the field and to the enrichment and sustainable development of the community at large
 * To effectively engage with the local community to promote education through their active participation
 * To promote in students, an appreciation and imbibing of the Indian cultural heritage and knowledge systems through inclusion of Indian languages and texts into education and research
2259.title: Overview

2260.content:
#### Our Vision
To be an institution of international repute fostering and enriching the learning environment, thus enabling knowledge, research and innovation, with human values in learners engaged in liberal education.
#### Programmes Offered
SoLA offers flexible undergraduate and postgraduate programs that allow students to customize their learning paths:
**Undergraduate Programmes (B.A. – Liberal Arts):Students can choose a Major and one or more Minors from diverse disciplines such as:**
 * Psychology
 * Political Science
 * English Literature

**Postgraduate Options:**
 * Master of Arts in Psychology
 * Master of Arts in Clinical Psychology
2260.title: Overview

2261.content:
#### Unique Features of SoLA
 * Interdisciplinary Learning: Students have the freedom to combine subjects across humanities, social sciences, and communication studies to create a personalized academic experience.
 * Choice-Based Credit System (CBCS): Encourages flexibility in curriculum and promotes self-directed learning.
 * Experiential Education: Includes projects, internships, community engagement, and real-world problem solving.
 * Skill Development: Emphasis on communication skills, research writing, critical thinking, and digital literacy.

#### Pedagogy
Teaching at SoLA is interactive, student-driven, and project-based. The curriculum blends theory with practice through:
 * Group discussions and debates
 * Field visits and case studies
 * Research projects and internships
 * Workshops and guest lectures by industry and academic experts
2261.title: Overview

GD Goenka University, where you can craft a degree that aligns with your passions and prepares you for a successful career in Liberal Arts.

2412.content:
# Career
The numerous disciplines that constitute the Liberal Arts have varying scopes, structures, and demands worldwide, including India. Psychology, Sociology, Political Science, English Literature, and Economics, are the disciplines that become important in a society where the asymmetries dominate, thereby contributing to its economic and social development. This can be achieved through an emphasis on critical and out-of-the-box thinking and research to help formulate policies. The subject matter of the disciplines undergoes constant revision and reformulation as they adapt to the ever-changing social structure. Even though the emphasis is on intensive learning, social scientists have extended their expertise to many institutions and excelled in every profession.
2412.title: Career

2413.content:
# Career

Social scientists can work with government and non-governmental institutions, multi-national corporations, research organizations, academia, and other sectors. Students of Liberal arts do not just try and understand the individuals, processes, institutions, and policies that define a social structure; instead, they become active agents of change within society with their knowledge. Moreover, whichever field or sector they are in, they do not remain circumscribed to their professions and contribute to society's betterment.
Along with the in-depth knowledge in their respective disciplines, social science students develop an analytical and reasoning acumen developed through their interdisciplinary accumulation of knowledge. Students of Liberal arts become trained in philosophical debates, theoretical approaches, ethics, research methods, problem analysis, policies, communication skills, and empathy through an intensive learning process.
2413.title: Career

2414.content:
# Career

School of Liberal Arts at G.D. Goenka University offers four/three years B.A. (Hons.) degree in Psychology, BsC Clinical Psychology (Hons). The school also offers two years M.A. degrees in Psychology, MA Clinical Psychology and Professional Diploma in Clinical Psychology.
2414.title: Career

2415.content:
### Career Pathway
##### Clinical Assistant
B.Sc. (Hons.) Clinical Psychology: A B.Sc. (Hons.) in Clinical Psychology prepares students for diverse entry-level roles across mental health, education, community services, and corporate settings. Graduates can work as clinical assistants supporting psychologists in assessments and interventions, or as counsellors in schools, NGOs, and hospitals. They may take up roles as mental health coordinators, facilitating community programmes or helplines, or become mental health trainers in educational institutions, training centres, and public health organisations.
2415.title: Career

2416.content:
### Career Pathway

Opportunities also exist as psycho-social support workers in crisis-intervention centres, disaster-relief initiatives, and humanitarian aid organisations. In addition, graduates can begin their careers as junior psychologists assisting with assessments and research, or as HR assistants applying psychological principles to employee wellness and talent development in corporate environments. This foundation opens pathways to further specialisation or postgraduate study in clinical, counselling, organisational, or community psychology.
##### Clinical Psychologist
2416.title: Career

2417.content:
### Career Pathway

##### Clinical Psychologist
M.A. Clinical Psychology: Master’s degree in Clinical Psychology equips postgraduates with advanced knowledge and hands-on skills to assess, diagnose, and manage a wide range of psychological and neurodevelopmental disorders. Graduates can work as clinical psychologists in hospitals, mental health clinics, or private practice, offering psychotherapy and psychological assessments. They may specialise as therapists in areas such as cognitivebehavioural therapy (CBT), family therapy, or trauma care. Opportunities also exist as academicians or researchers, teaching at universities or conducting mental health research. As rehabilitation specialists, graduates support individuals with disabilities or chronic conditions in rehabilitation centres.
2417.title: Career

2418.content:
### Career Pathway

They can also serve as consultants, providing expert testimony in legal cases or advising organisations on mental health policies. Many choose to establish independent practice as licensed clinical psychologists, building their own client base and offering specialised services. This degree thus opens diverse pathways in clinical, academic, community, and consultancy roles within the mental-health sector.
##### Associate Clinical Psychologist
2418.title: Career

2419.content:
### Career Pathway

##### Associate Clinical Psychologist
Professional Diploma in Clinical Psychology: It prepares graduates for supervised, entry-level roles in mental health settings. Diploma holders can work as associate clinical psychologists, assisting licensed professionals in hospitals, mental health facilities, or rehabilitation units with assessments and therapy. They may serve as mental health practitioners in community care centres, schools, or NGOs, focusing on short-term interventions and support. Opportunities also exist as counsellors in nursing homes, schools, or outpatient clinics, though independent practice is not permitted at this level.
In addition, graduates can work as support staff in psychiatric wards or specialty clinics, assisting in diagnostic and therapeutic services. This qualification offers a practical foundation for those seeking hands-on experience in mental health care and can serve as a stepping stone to advanced degrees or licensure in clinical psychology.
2419.title: Career

2420.content:
### Career Pathway

##### Foundational roles: Counseling and Human-Services
B.A. (H) Psychology: A bachelor's degree in psychology opens up opportunities in human or social services. Typical jobs in this field of work are career counsellor, psychiatric technician, rehabilitation specialist, child care workers, social service specialists and case manager. These jobs all require skills such as the ability to evaluate the needs of a client, to keep accurate and organized records, to express empathy and compassion, and to work towards the best interests of your client, which a bachelor's degree in psychology provides.
You are also prepared for a multitude of careers (research, education, sales, the justice system, human resources, private practice, etc.) and you learn valuable tools that you can use to accurately examine and assess individuals and situations, an asset at any job. The graduates are also recruited as advertising agents, laboratory assistants, market researchers and educators.
2420.title: Career

2421.content:
### Career Pathway

The average salary for these graduates at the start of the career ranges between INR 3-5 lakhs per annum depending on their expertise and experience in the field.
##### Counseling and Human Resource careers
2421.title: Career

2422.content:
### Career Pathway

##### Counseling and Human Resource careers
M.A. Psychology: This programme focusses on therapies and behavioural modification techniques. Individuals with M.A. degree in Psychology often work as school counsellors or career counsellors. They may also be employed in private practices, mental health clinics or hospitals. Counseling psychologists work in a variety of settings, providing various services to different client populations. Some are employed in colleges and universities as teachers, researchers and service providers (e.g., in university Counseling centres). Others work in independent practice, providing Counseling, assessment and consultation services to individuals, couples, families, and organizations. Still, others work in community mental health centres, health maintenance organizations, rehabilitation agencies, and business and industrial organizations.
2422.title: Career

2423.content:
### Career Pathway

Other domains where Counseling psychologists can find jobs are in the following domains: marriage and family counsellors, substance abuse counsellors, mental health counsellors. They may also play a role as a training and development officer or manager and can become HR specialists. They can also serve a employee wellness program coordinators.
The average salary for these postgraduates ranges between INR 5 to 8 lakhs per annum as per the expertise and their experience in this field.

Goenka University, themed - “Thrive: The Resilient Mind.” The event brought together distinguished speakers, entrepreneurs, educators, diplomats, innovators, and thought leaders to engage in meaningful conversations on resilience, transformation, leadership, and purposeful growth in a rapidly changing world. The event commenced at 9:00 AM and witnessed enthusiastic participation from students, academicians, professionals, and invited guests.
The programme began with the ceremonial lamp lighting followed by a graceful Ganesh Vandana performance. The inaugural address was delivered by Dr. Dinesh Shenoy, Vice-Chancellor of the university, who emphasized the importance of resilience, innovation, critical thinking, and compassionate leadership in shaping future ready individuals, highlighting how platforms such as TEDx encourage intellectual engagement, creativity, and socially meaningful dialogue among young minds.

Dr. Anjali Midha Sharan, Dean of Research & Development and School of Liberal Arts, introduced the central TEDx theme and reflected on the importance of moving beyond survival towards intentional growth, and emotional resilience.
TEDxGDGDU 2026 featured 16 distinguished speakers from diverse fields including entrepreneurship, education, fitness, diplomacy, design, mental health, leadership, and public policy. Through a series of engaging talks and interactive sessions, the speakers shared powerful insights on emotional resilience, redefining productivity, quiet leadership, entrepreneurship, motherhood, wellbeing, and personal transformation. ### Session on Music Therapy

On February 11, 2026, the School of Liberal Arts at G.D. Goenka University organized a session titled **“Healing Aspects of Music in Building Confidence and Calm,”** conducted by Dr. Shambhavi Das, a music healer, TEDx speaker, and founder of the Manonaad Centre for Music Healing and Education. The session explored how sound and vibration influence emotional well-being by combining music therapy, neuroscience, and Vedic philosophy.
Dr. Das explained how music can influence brain waves and emotional states, and introduced the Vedic concept of **Naad Brahma** , highlighting the therapeutic potential of Indian classical ragas and mantras. 2457.content:
## Top Culinary and Hotel Management College in Delhi NCR

# Overview
The India campus of the renowned culinary institute Le Cordon Bleu is located within GD Goenka University's prestigious School of Hospitality and Tourism in Gurugram. Established in 2013, it offers a variety of programmes including short courses, one-year diplomas, four-year undergraduate degrees, and two-year master’s degrees. The curriculum is designed to align with industry demands, focusing on experiential learning to prepare students for real-world careers.
With state-of-the-art facilities, the campus provides a vibrant college life and opportunities for interdisciplinary learning through additional programmes across the university.
2457.title: Overview

2458.content:
#### Our Academic Alliance:
Le Cordon Bleu, founded in 1895, is globally renowned as the birthplace of culinary arts and hospitality excellence. With a legacy that spans over a century, it has shaped some of the world’s most celebrated chefs and industry leaders, continuing to influence the culinary world today.
Originally established in Paris by MartheDistel, publisher of La Cuisinière Cordon Bleu magazine, the institute has evolved by blending tradition with innovation. It offers a range of programmess, including Bachelor’s and Master’s degrees, and Certificate Courses, all tailored to meet the demands of the growing global hospitality industry.
Today, Le Cordon Bleu is the largest network of culinary and hospitality schools worldwide, with more than 35 campuses across 20 countries, training 20,000 students from over 100 nationalities each year.
2458.title: Overview

2459.content:
#### Chef Thierry Le Baut, Academic Director
Michelin Star Chef Thierry Le Baut, Academic Director at LeCordon Bleu, Gurugram, brings 44 years ofunparalleled global culinary expertise. His distinguished careerspans France, the United Kingdom, Germany, Canada, Spain,New Zealand, Taiwan, the Philippines, Malaysia, and India.
Chef Le Baut began his journey in 1982, working with Michelin-starred establishments such as La Taupinière (France), Clara’sand Horcher (Spain), Chewton Glen Hotel (UK), Hotel Traube(Germany), The Chateau, and MaisonFrançaise (Malaysia).
2459.title: Overview

2460.content:
#### Chef Thierry Le Baut, Academic Director

Trained under Michelin-starred chef Martin Berasategui at El Bulli(Spain), he has also collaborated with renowned names like Viridiana and Casino Madrid. Holding a B.E.P and C.A.P in Cuisine from LycéeChaptal and aB.E.P.C from Lycée Jean Moulin, France, Chef Le Baut is acelebrated author of Cuisinier and a contributor to prestigiouspublications, including CocinaFuturo, Placet, and Wine &Gastronomy. His enduring passion and expertise continue toinspire and redefine the global culinary landscape.

### Buzz and Brand Trivia Marketing Quiz

Financial Planning and Smart Investment Sessions by the Finance Club
The Finance Club at the School of Management recently organized two enlightening sessions aimed at equipping students with essential knowledge on financial planning and smart investment strategies. These sessions provided practical insights to help attendees balance present financial needs with future security.
The first session was conducted by Mr. Surya Kant Sharma, a former SEBI official and AMFI consultant, who emphasized the importance of cultivating financial discipline. He discussed critical habits such as setting clear financial goals, reinvesting returns to leverage the power of compounding, and protecting investments through adequate insurance. He encouraged students to take the first step by starting simple, suggesting Systematic Investment Plans (SIPs) in diversified mutual funds as an excellent entry point for young investors.
2506.title: Buzz And Brand Trivia Marketing Quiz

2507.content:
### Buzz and Brand Trivia Marketing Quiz

The second session, led by Mr. Sudhir Alewa, a SEBI-registered analyst, delved into the intricacies of stock market investments. He introduced students to strategies for successful Initial Public Offering (IPO) bidding and guided them on selecting promising stocks using both fundamental and technical analysis. His practical approach helped demystify the stock market, making it accessible and less intimidating for novice investors.
Both sessions were rich in practical knowledge and actionable advice. The speakers shared real-world examples and tips, enabling students to understand the significance of long-term financial planning and informed investment decisions.
The event was highly engaging and well-received by the attendees, who appreciated the speakers’ expertise and relatable advice. These sessions reaffirmed the Finance Club’s commitment to enhancing students’ financial literacy and preparing them for future financial success.

2513.content:
### The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts Launches LCoE in Partnership with GD Goenka University and Le Cordon Bleu

The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts has announced the launch of the Leela Centre of Excellence (LCoE), a strategic initiative designed to build a future-ready talent pipeline.
As the company plans to expand from 15 to 24 hotels over the next three years, the initiative is expected to play a key role in inducting, training, and developing more than 3,000 associates across The Leela’s luxury ecosystem. The LCoE will focus on strengthening leadership capabilities, operational excellence, and service standards to support the brand’s long-term growth strategy.
**Partnership and Infrastructure**
Developed in association with Le Cordon Bleu and GD Goenka University, part of the GD Goenka Group operating over 150+ K12 schools across the country, the LCoE strengthens The Leela’s learning ecosystem during a key phase of the brand’s expansion.
2513.title: The Leela Palaces Hotels And Resorts Launches Lcoe In Partnership With Gd Goenka University And Le Cordon Bleu

2514.content:
### The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts Launches LCoE in Partnership with GD Goenka University and Le Cordon Bleu

Spread across approximately 9,600 sq. ft. of infrastructure within the 50,000 sq. ft. GD Goenka School of Hospitality & Culinary Management, the Centre includes classrooms, an auditorium, specialised training kitchens, and integrated residential and recreational facilities.
Guided by faculty and industry practitioners, the Centre combines academic learning with hospitality training and introduces academic pathways such as a BBA in Hospitality aligned with NEP 2020, along with dual certifications through Le Cordon Bleu and GD Goenka University.
**Talent Development and Training**
As The Leela expands its hospitality portfolio, the LCoE is also positioned as a long-term investment in hospitality talent development. The company will annually invest in structured learning and capability-building initiatives impacting over 650 associates and managers.
2514.title: The Leela Palaces Hotels And Resorts Launches Lcoe In Partnership With Gd Goenka University And Le Cordon Bleu

2515.content:
### The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts Launches LCoE in Partnership with GD Goenka University and Le Cordon Bleu

This includes leadership and functional development programmes for more than 250 managers through its Leela Executive Accelerated Development (LEAD) programme, along with academic and operational training for associates across The Leela Palace Services (TLPS), Leela Leadership Development Programme (LLDP), and Butler Development programmes.
The initiative will also include soft skills training for over 200 associates annually and culinary capability-building under Shefs at The Leela for 30 culinary professionals each year.
 Nipun Goenka, Managing Director, GD Goenka Group and Pro-Chancellor, GD Goenka University, and Anuraag Bhatnagar, Chief Executive Officer, The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts.

As we expand, it is critical that our people, culture and service standards evolve with consistency. The LCoE brings together global partnerships and operational depth to build a strong pipeline of talent aligned with our values. It is an investment in people, culture and capability that will support our next phase of growth.”

# Overview
The School of Law at GD Goenka University is a premier institution of legal education in India, recognized among the Top Law Schools in North India by Legal World and Outlook Rankings and awarded Most Promising Law School in India by Competition Success Review (2024). Established in 2014 and approved by the Bar Council of India, the School has consistently championed excellence in legal pedagogy, research, community service, and professional development.
Our academic model is built on clinical and outcome-based legal education, aligned with national priorities and global standards. The curriculum features 21 core subjects, 6 optional papers, 8 honours courses, and a diverse pool of 54 electives, empowering students with both a strong legal foundation and sector-specific expertise. Our course offerings address local, regional, national, and international legal challenges, covering areas such as:
 * Cyber Law and Artificial Intelligence
 * Intellectual Property Rights (IPR)

2528.content:
# Overview

Students can opt for dual specializations such as IPR with Corporate Law, Criminal Law with Cyber Law and AI, and Arbitration and Mediation with International Trade Law, making them highly adaptable in a dynamic legal job market.
We place strong emphasis on experiential learning, integrating 15–30% clinical components into the curriculum. Our students routinely engage in:
 * Moot court exercises and ideathons
 * Trial advocacy and client counseling
 * Live streaming of Supreme Court proceedings
 * Model United Nations (MUN) and interdisciplinary research projects

2529.content:
#### Centres of Excellence
The School hosts multiple specialized research and policy centres, each fostering excellence in its domain:
 * Centre for Conflict Resolution (CCR): Offers professional training in Arbitration, Mediation, and Online Dispute Resolution (ODR), in collaboration with CIArb, and the Indian Institute of Arbitration and Mediation (IIAM). CCR trains students and faculty to become certified neutrals and promotes technology-led dispute resolution.
 * Centre for Women and Child: Dedicated to gender justice and child protection, conducting socio-legal research, legal literacy drives, and advocacy campaigns.
 * Centre for IP Studies, Research and Extension: Facilitates in-depth academic and policy work on intellectual property rights and technology law.
 * Centre for Corporate Law, Policy Research and Governance: Specializes in corporate governance, financial regulations, and business policy analysis.
2529.title: Overview

2530.content:
#### Centres of Excellence

* Centre for Corporate Law, Policy Research and Governance: Specializes in corporate governance, financial regulations, and business policy analysis.
 * Centre for Constitutional Law and Human Rights: Focuses on the promotion and protection of constitutional values and civil liberties.
 * Centre for Environmental and Sustainable Development: Engages in environmental law research and supports initiatives aligned with SDG 13 and climate justice.
 * Pro Bono Club (under the Ministry of Law & Justice, Government of India): Encourages a culture of voluntary legal service, facilitating access to justice for underprivileged communities.
2530.title: Overview

2531.content:
#### Judicial and Professional Preparation
The Judicial Training and Coaching Centre (JTCC) serves as a dedicated training wing for aspiring judicial officers and litigators. It offers structured test preparation, faculty mentorship, and mock court simulations.
Student-led bodies like the Clinical Legal Aid Centre, Electoral Club, and Student Think Tank offer co-curricular platforms to develop legal reasoning, public service ethics, and leadership skills. These initiatives directly contribute to SDG 16 – Peace, Justice, and Strong Institutions and SDG 5 – Gender Equality.
##### Infrastructure, Research, and Global Integration
The School of Law ensures a comprehensive academic and professional environment with:
 * Advanced Learning Management Systems (LMS) and ICT-enabled classrooms
 * Digitally equipped libraries and access to international legal databases
 * Annual Law Summits, Moot Court Competitions, International Lecture Series, and Industry Conclaves

* Digitally equipped libraries and access to international legal databases

2532.title: Overview

2533.content:
#### Judicial and Professional Preparation

Our graduates excel in diverse domains—corporate legal teams, judiciary, policy-making, and legal tech entrepreneurship. Significant alumni contributions have supported curriculum development, infrastructure enhancement, and student welfare.
Our faculty includes Honorary Professors, Adjunct Professors, and Professors of Practice, combining scholarly rigor with real-world insight.
2533.title: Overview

2534.content:
#### Our Mission
To prepare socially responsible legal professionals through
 * Strong foundation in the fundamentals linking knowledge and skills through experiential learning
 * Innovative pedagogical approach and research infrastructure to groom legal professionals
 * Collaboration with leading legal institutions on Interdisciplinary projects that instill team-based problem-solving skills
 * Emphasis on professional ethics to ensure sustainable contribution towards society and even protection of new and original native intellectual and cultural knowledge rights
 * Incorporation of emerging domains including digitalization, entrepreneurship and environmental compliance into the curriculum to enable digitalised and environmentally compliant, society, business, and governance for sustainable development
 * Inculcation of adoption of best practices and technology to ensure timely delivery of justice
2534.title: Overview

2535.content:

To be an institution of excellence in legal education enabling socially and ethically responsible legal professionals with competence in research, innovation and entrepreneurship.
#### Join us at the School of Law, GD Goenka University
where academic excellence meets real-world impact, and students are nurtured to become ethical, competent, and visionary legal professionals.

Message from Dean
# Dr. Aneesha PR, Dean, School of Law
### Dr. Aneesha PR, Dean, School of Law
Welcome to the School of Law at GD Goenka University. We are a vibrant community of learners, thinkers, and doers—committed to shaping legal professionals who combine knowledge with integrity, innovation, and a sense of justice.
Our approach to legal education goes beyond classrooms. With a blend of strong academics, experiential learning through moot courts, legal aid, research, and industry exposure, we prepare our students to meet the challenges of a rapidly changing world.
At GD Goenka, we believe in nurturing not only successful lawyers but also responsible citizens who will use the law as a tool for positive change. I invite you to explore our programs, engage with our initiatives, and be part of a journey that empowers you to make a difference.
Dr. Aneesha PR
